entries.name: Regulus Corneas relationship first wife
entries.content: As a boy, Regulus loved a village girl. After gaining the Witch Factor, he slaughtered her family, broke her mind, and forced her to marry him. She never smiled, but he only cared for her beauty. She later killed herself, smiling for the first time. Enraged, Regulus swore to never be alone again and forbade future wives from showing emotion, executing any who did. She was the only wife he gave a grave.

entries.name: Great Rabbit
entries.content: The Great Rabbit, one of the Three Great Witchbeasts, was created by Daphne with an insatiable hunger, causing it to devour anything, including itself if no food was available. It operated as a collective consciousness of countless rabbits that could multiply infinitely, making it nearly impossible to kill. it is not called the great rabbit because it is big but because they are small but many of them. Each rabbit resembled an Earth rabbit but had sharp teeth, a horn, and a fluorescent sigil. The Witch of Gluttony designed it as a renewable food source, though its replication ability made it difficult to defeat. It followed strong magical signatures to locate prey and cared only about satisfying its endless hunger.

entries.name: Roswaal's Mansion
entries.content: Roswaal's Mansion is a giant white house with five watchtowers with the fifth one being the center one, a giant garden and a black roof. It is surrounded with a forest known as the Kremaldy Forest and has a basement that has an almost as big surface as the mansion it self.

entries.name: bathroom
entries.content: The bathroom can be used as a sauna and has a few marble pillars in it. It has a bath in the center of the room with in the center of the bath an golden pillar.

entries.name: dining room
entries.content: In the dining room, all the people in the mansion gather to eat. In this place there is a large table covered with a white tablecloth, on each side there are several chairs, and regardless of the time, lights are placed on the table. The wall is green and has certain white spaces. Behind the table there is a figure in a painting, possibly a relative of the Roswaal family.

entries.name: entrance
entries.content: Upon entering Roswaal's Mansion, it's noted that the mansion retains great elegance. There are two pillars with a pair of lamps each. In addition to having high class designs, there are lights near each door, as well as vases with flowers. On the road there are two routes to the sides, right and left, and stairs to go up to the next floor.

entries.name: garden
entries.content: The garden is located on the outskirts of the mansion, it has several characteristics, such as that it is full of grass, besides there are also several paths where you can walk. On the sides you can see small fields full of flowers, you can also see some large trees and other small trees, as well as bushes. There are also places to rest.

entries.name: Guest room
entries.content: The guest room is the place where the head invites their visitors to talk. It has three green furniture and a small rectangular table in the center, to its surroundings there are also windows with light green curtains. there is a fireplace and above a picture showing a drawing.

entries.name: kitchen
entries.content: The kitchen is where the servants of Roswaal prepare breakfast, lunch and dinner. It is full of plates, pots, jars, rollers, knives and other things that can be used to prepare food. Ingredients are stored inside barrels.

entries.name: manor
entries.content: Roswaal's Mansion Residents: Roswaal L Mathers (current Owner), Ram (Maid), Rem (Maid), Beatrice (Resident), Emilia (Royal Candidate Resident)

entries.name: forbidden library
entries.content:
The Forbidden Library was a massive library built by the Witch of Greed with the purpose of housing her vast knowledge converted into Magical Books. Some time before the Witch's demise, she installed Beatrice as the Library's keeper.. The Forbidden Library is the most knowledgeable place in Lugnica.
Appearance-wise, The Forbidden Library is a huge two-story space with a spiral stair in the center of the room. The second floor consists of a large balcony which is filled to the brim with bookshelves. Despite it being accessible through any of the Roswaal's Manor's doors, the Library itself isn't inherently part of the mansion, as it exists in a separate dimension that can be accessed through the teleportation mechanic called Door Crossing.

entries.name: Oni
entries.content: Oni: Among the numerous humanoid races that existed in world, they are considered the mightiest. Their powerful bodies and potency of mana granted them peerless combat strength. Only visible physical difference between an Oni and human are a pair of long curved-horns that sprout from the foreheads of Oni when their lives were in danger. The horns would absorb mana from atmosphere greatly increasing Oni's physical and magical capabilities. if an Oni looses a horn, it can not be grown back by healing magic. Oni can have many different eye colors, horn colors, and hair colors.

entries.name: Hornless
entries.content: Oni with no horns that are considered the dregs of their society because of it. Moreover, Oni born that way were to be killed by tradition to protect the Oni pride as a powerful and nearly perfect species. ram is hornless.

entries.name: Witch Factor
entries.content:
Witch factor: Antithesis of Od Laguna and the Authorities granted by them can be considered the backward compatibility of Divine Protections. The Witch Factors used by the Sin Archbishops originally belonged to the Witches of Sin and the Witches before, there is no real difference between the two as they're all just good-for-nothings compatible with the Witch Factors that are called differently due to different eras and positions. They can manifest in a physical or in a non-physical form.
If a Witch Factor is forcibly inserted into someone incompatible with it, it will greatly alter their personality.

entries.name: Authority
entries.content: Authority: Manifested within people after they take in Witch/Warlock Factors. No Divine Protection can overpower an Authority. Authorities are like admin privileges to the world. they give people/holder who have them the right to interfere with the world in some way. The powers of each Authority are shaped into existence based on a compatible holder's desire, however, the hosts have no control over what kind of ability is born out of their "sin".

entries.name: Sin archbishop
entries.content: The current Sin Archbishops are: Sin Archbishop of Wrath Sirius Romanée-Conti, Sin Archbishop of Lust Capella Emerada Lugunica, Sin Archbishop of Gluttony Roy Alphard,  Sin Archbishop of Gluttony Lye Batenkaitos, Sin Archbishop of Sloth Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti, Sin Archbishop of Gluttony Louis Arneb, Sin Archbishop of Greed Regulus Corneas,

entries.name: Witches of Sin
entries.content:
The Witches of Sin were:
Satella, the Witch of Envy
Echidna, the Witch of Greed
Minerva, the Witch of Wrath
Typhon, the Witch of Pride
Sekhmet, the Witch of Sloth
Daphne, the Witch of Gluttony
Carmilla, the Witch of Lust.
Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory
Hector, the Warlock of Melancholy.

Each witch has two image colors that represent them; Echidna's were white and black, Minerva's were blue and white, Sekhmet's were black and grey, Daphne's were black and purple, Typhon's were blue and green, Carmilla's were red and pink, Pandora's are gold and white, and Hector's are gold and brown. 

Although all of the Witches of Sin, except Satella, Pandora and hector are dead, before she died Echidna collected the other Witches' souls, and she eventually went to the Sanctuary. With the faint hope of opposing the Witch of Envy, her soul was sealed there by the Mathers' magic at Volcanica's instruction, causing her own soul to persist after the death of her body.

entries.name: Abiate
entries.content: Abiate is a city in southern Lugnica. The McMahon manor is located a half day's journey from the city.

entries.name: Agante
entries.content: Agante is a bandit town in southwestern Lugnica near the Barony of Barielle.

entries.name: Aihiya Swamp
entries.content: Aihiya Swamp: A wetland that is located in the southern region of Lugnica and borders the Vollachia Empire. It was a site of the largest battle of the Demi-Human War. The swamps were adjacent to the base of operations for the Demi-human alliance's leadership.

entries.name: Augria Sand Dunes
entries.content: The Augria Sand Dunes is an area located in the far eastern part of the Kingdom of Lugnica. Due to its close proximity to the Witch's Shrine, the Augria Sand Dunes has a high concentration of witch miasma, making it an ideal place for Demon Beasts to live. Demon Beasts that live here are stronger and more aggressive than normal, though few actually live in the area.

entries.name: Bonobo
entries.content: Bonobo: A city near the capital of Lugnica. It is located between Mill Gray and Cramlin on the Lifaus Highway. The town is famous for its distilleries.

entries.name: Coffleton
entries.content: Coffleton: A hamlet on the southernmost tip of the Barielle Territories. The hamlet is smaller than the Barielle estate. According to the census records, there are 88 residents. It’s located at the basin of the Tenrill river.

entries.name: Costuul
entries.content: Costuul: A bustling Demi-Human town near the main residence of the Mathers Head family with a population that is close to 100,000. It is rumored that Costuul used to be a dragon pit. Costuul is regarded as one of the five regional capitals of Lugnica and is its most recent, having been boosted to that status due to its bustling industry using the Magicreation Tools.

entries.name: Cramlin
entries.content: Cramlin: A town located southeast near the capital of Lugnica and near the Lifaus Highway, lying next to Mount Cordor. It has caves lying near the town, one of which was inhabited by a Sunamimizu.

entries.name: Elior Forest
entries.content: Elior Forest: A dense woodland forest currently owned by Roswaal where the Elves once lived. It is located in the northeastern part of Lugnica and north-east of Roswaal's old mansion. The village owned its own seal, which was guarded by the Elves. About 100 years ago, the forest was attacked by both Pandora and Regulus Corneas, which ended up causing the large area to be frozen over by Emilia.

entries.name: Flanders
entries.content: Flanders is one of Lugnica's five regional capitals located in the southeastern part of the country in the Hyclara Plateau. It is also known as the Earth Dragon Capital due to being known as the place where Earth Dragons originated from. The land here is blessed by the Volcanica so that Earth Dragons would be born. It's famed for having what is known as a "dragon industry" since the city makes use of its Earth Dragons beyond transport labor, such as powering water wheels, opening and closing canals, or raising and lowering drawbridges. These innovations are only made possible due to the abundance of Earth Dragons there. The Astrea territory is located nearby.

entries.name: Forest of the Elves
entries.content: Forest of the Elves is a relatively large forest located west of Flanders.

entries.name: Fourtour Plains
entries.content: Fourtour Plains: An area of wilderness in the Karsten lands where animals like the Ubuzu can be found.

entries.name: Ganaks
entries.content: Ganaks: A mining city located near Elior Forest northeast from it. The city lies at the foot of the Gina mountain range. In addition to its prolific mining industry, Ganaks is famed for its entertainment district. At night, Ganaks' main street is illuminated by the lights of gorgeous crystal lamps. Away from the main street, Ganaks is home to a violent underworld.

entries.name: Gina Mountain Range
entries.content: Gina Mountain Range: A mountain range where, according to legend, Volcanica once lived. It has become a magic ore mining source and permission is required from the kingdom to enter it. The mountain range lies in the northeast of Lugnica.

entries.name: Guineb
entries.content: Guineb is an inconspicuous city in the mountains of southern Lugnica. The town is built around a magic ore mine, however, the mine is already depleted.

entries.name: Hakchuri
entries.content: Hakchuri is the only small city within the Astrea territory and is where the Astrea Mansion is located. The Hyclara Plateaus lies between it and Flanders. Its main industries are agriculture, livestock, and Earth Dragons. Brown-haired people are more common in the area while blonde-haired people are more common near the capital.

entries.name: Hanumas
entries.content: Hanumas: A border village that sits on the entrance to the Mathers domain. It's located north-east of the capital.

entries.name: Irlam Village
entries.content: Irlam Village is a village located near Roswaal's Mansion with a population of around 300 people. The name of the village changes based on the surname of the current head. There is also a youth group created by young people in the village.

entries.name: Kremaldy
entries.content: Kremaldy is the name of the dense forest that surrounds the Sanctuary. It is nicknamed "The Lost Forest" due to the barrier that has prevented explorers from fully exploring its depths.

entries.name: Ladrima
entries.content: Ladrima: A village in southwestern Lugnica that borders the Vollachia Empire in the southern part of the Barony of Barielle. It lies east of the Barielle mansion.

entries.name: Lifaus Highway
entries.content: Lifaus Highway: A vast thoroughfare nearby to where Flugel's Tree stands. The tree is gargantuan enough that it can be seen for miles.

entries.name: Mill Gray
entries.content: Mill Gray: A city near the capital. It is located west of Fleur near the Lifaus Highway. The town is famous for its windmills.

entries.name: Mirula
entries.content: Mirula is the closest town to the Augria Sand Dunes. The town is described as a practically deserted town, considerably smaller than Lugnica's main cities. The town is located north from the Kingdom's largest forest, and just west of the Dunes. The town experiences the "Sand Time" from the Augria Sand Dunes, to which its few residents shut themselves inside. It's stated that many travelers that challenge the Augria Sand Dunes pass through this town.

entries.name: Mount Cordor
entries.content: Mount Cordor: A mountain that is also known as Nest of the Earthsnakes is near the town of Cramlin.

entries.name: Pappelt
entries.content: Pappelt: A town in the south of Lugnica where Regin Suwen, Otto's younger brother, lives. This town is endangered by the Earth Spider's web.

entries.name: Picoutatte
entries.content: Picoutatte is one of Kingdom's five regional capitals, located in the very south of the Kingdom, next to the Kingdom's border with the Empire. It is a beautiful merchant city separated into five different areas: north, south, east, west, and central. The rules and features are different in each area. The Suwen Trading Company is located in the west area. The city itself has a unique Arabian flair with both the architecture of the structures and the dress codes of the citizens greatly resembling that from the Arabian Peninsula, from earth. The city itself is of great importance to the Kingdom, as it's the main trading hub with the neighboring Empire.

entries.name: Priestella
entries.content: Also known as the Water Gate City, Priestella is one of the five regional capitals of the Kingdom of Lugnica and is the closest to Kararagi with the Tigracy River separating them. It is a beautiful city and a famous tourist location that is built in the middle of a great lake, with waterways running through the city. It is also the birthplace of Hoshin of the Wilderness and has been long associated with merchants because of its proximity to Kararagi. Priestella is led by the Priestellan Council of Ten.

entries.name: Shamrock Valley
entries.content: Shamrock Valley: A valley southeast of Lugnica where the Sphinx's Testing Ground is located. Always enshrouded by thick fog. The grounds cannot be entered without her od or something that contains it.

entries.name: Astrea Mansion
entries.content: The Astrea Mansion is a big mansion with flower beds in the garden that Wilhelm van Astrea liked. It lies north-west of Flanders.

entries.name: sanctuary
entries.content: The Sanctuary is a poor village located within Roswaal's territory that has been taken care of by the various Mathers over the years. The village itself is a group of buildings located in a clearing within the forest and only halves live there. It is surrounded by a short fence with an old stone gate at the entrance. Although Roswaal refers to it as the Sanctuary, the villagers refer to it as the Witch of Greed's Graveyard. The place itself is situated east of Roswaal's old manor.

entries.name: Healing Institute
entries.content: Healing Institute: A facility where excellent healers are gathered from all over the country. It is located in the Noble District of the capital of Lugnica.

entries.name: Knights Garrison
entries.content: Knights Garrison: It is the main headquarters of the Kingdom's Knights and where its elite, the Royal Guard, are stationed. The garrison itself is adjacent to the Royal Castle of Lugnica.

entries.name: Agriculture,Agricultural
entries.content: Considering the immense size of the Kingdom's population even during times of hardship, Lugnica has an enhanced agricultural industry, yielding exotic fruits and all sorts of products such apples, lemons, peppers, and sugar at consistent rates, allowing the population to remain stable.

entries.name: lugnica Barrer
entries.content: It is worth noting, however, that after forming a covenant with the Kingdom, Volcanica "deployed" some sort of a "barrier" all across the Kingdom's lands. This barrier–for lack of a better term–acts like a magical warning system, which alerts the Divine Dragon, every time the covenant requires him to act, allowing Volcanica to assist the Kingdom in accordance to the four centuries old covenant.

entries.name: captial lugnica
entries.content: Lugnica Capital City: divided into five circular layers, which are also known as districts, that are organized top down much like a feudal structure. The highest and first layer is traditionally the land of the royalty, with the Council of Elders and the most important nobles being the only ones who are permitted to live there. The second layer, also known as the Nobles' District, is dominated by the nobility and the wealthy, usually sport their manors and villas. The third layer is dedicated primarily towards economic and commercial purposes. The fourth layer has residences of the average citizenry. The fifth district is fittingly named the Poor District.

entries.name: Craft Sector
entries.content: Lugnica Craft Sector: Also considering the extensive use of cut stone and in the construction of many of Lugnica's cities, Lugnica also has an advanced craft sector composed of skilled stone masons, architects, and city planners. Engineering feats, such as wide paved roads in its major cities, working water fountains in marketplaces, and the waterworks projects in Priestella give a sense of the advanced state of infrastructure, and thus society in urban Lugnica, which is already far past the state of things in our Medieval Era.

entries.name: Government,leaders,monarch
entries.content: Lugnica is also referred to as the Dragon Kingdom Lugnica, having prospered in the past due to the covenant with the Dragon. As all known members of the royal family are now deceased, martial law is currently in effect, with the Sage Council taking over the role of government for the time being. In accordance with the prophetical Dragon Tablet, five young women have been selected as candidates to become the Dragon Maiden and the elected monarch.

entries.name: Demi-Human
entries.content: Demi-human: The general term for all humanoid species such as Beast-humans, Oni, Giants, Elves, various Reptilian races etc. They are found throughout the world, though some are unique to specific regions. Although their social status and treatment vary by country with Gusteko being the worst. Half elves and similar mixed-bloods are particularly detested due to the similarities of their birth with the Witch of Envy which has extended to demi-humankind in general to a lesser degree.

entries.name: Economics,Economy,Currency
entries.content: Coinage in Lugnica comes in four known types of coins. The lowest denomination of coin is the copper coin, which has the figure of the royal castle on it. The second denomination of coin is the silver coin, which has the figure of the Sage on it. The third denomination of coin is the gold coin, which has the figure of the first Sword Saint on it. And finally, the most valuable coin is the sacred gold coin, which has the figure of the Dragon on it.

entries.name: Lugnica
entries.content: The country contains several regions where mountains and hills are common, with the most prominent peaks located in the Royal Capital region. The country is expansive enough that it can support a wide range of different environments, from large temperate forests to Mediterranean climate regions to desert areas with sand dunes. Lugnica, in reality, doesn't seem to be all that big of a nation, considering the travel distances by foot, but since the country is seldom explored by the characters in the story, any attempts to estimate the size of the kingdom are simply impossible.

entries.name: bordering Vollachia,Lugnica Location,bordering Gusteko,easternmost country
entries.content: The Kingdom of Lugnica is the easternmost country on the continent, bordering Gusteko to its north, Vollachia to its south, and Kararagi to the west.

entries.name: top mage,Best mage,strongest mage
entries.content: The best mages of each of the six elements are given a color title, which are aliases that show their skill with a particular element. These titles were first created when Lugnica reorganized the basis of their magic system following the Demi-Human War. Currently, Blue (water) belongs to Ferris Argyle, Red (fire), Green (wind), and Yellow (earth) are the titles of Roswaal L Mathers, while Black (yin) and White (yang) are vacant.

entries.name: military
entries.content: Lugnica's national army is the Royal Army, which is currently headed by Marcos Gildark. Beyond them, there are various provincial armies that help defend the country's border governed by regional lords. The country is also in the possession of by far the greatest military asset in the known world: the Sword Saint, Reinhard van Astrea, as well as the still active Divine Dragon. Luckily for other nations and adversaries of the government, the Kingdom is much too unwieldy to bring its full strength to bear nor will the Divine Dragon assist in an invasion.

entries.name: population
entries.content: The Kingdom of Lugnica is approximately 50 million people, mostly human, but there is also a large minority of Demi-Humans, or humanoids with animal-like features to varying degrees. The Royal Capital, the city of Lugnica, is mentioned to have a population of around 300,000. Elves and half-elves are known to inhabit Lugnica, as do many sentient Spirits.

entries.name: religion
entries.content: The country worships the Dragon as its national deity and he is bound by a covenant established with the Lugnica royal family centuries ago. Imagery of the Dragon is seen in nearly every corner of Lugnica, despite the Dragon disassociating himself from the royalty. Figures such as the Sage and the first Sword Saint also seem to gather a worthy and comparable amount of respect, in both a biblical and secular manner.

entries.name: Workforce
entries.content: Fifteen is considered the legal age of adulthood in Lugnica and is the time people typically begin to enter the workforce. They're also allowed certain privileges, such as drinking and smoking. Slavery is illegal, thus all servants must be treated as employees and paid appropriately.

entries.name: market street
entries.content: Market Street: Situated in the Commercial District of Lugnica, it is the main thoroughfare that connects to all parts of the city and central commercial area in the capital. Notably, there is a board sign at the entrance for the official currency exchange rates for money.

entries.name: prison tower
entries.content: The Prison Tower is a tower adjacent to the royal castle in the capital of Lugnica and is used to imprison those who have committed serious crimes, such as murderers and rapists.

entries.name: training ground
entries.content: Training Ground: A circular shaped colosseum adjacent to the Royal Guard's Barracks, the Training Ground is, as the name implies, mainly used for training. Knights from different garrisons visit the structure daily, in order to hone their skill with the blade. The training ground has bore witness to many battles, such as the famous Silver Flower Dance of the Sword Saint and the Blue Lightning.

entries.name: Elior Forest
entries.content: Elior Forest is a dense woodland forest located in north eastern Lugnica, south west from the mining city of Ganaks and the Gina mountain range. Elior Forest is covered in snow and ice, and is home to unnatural mana storms and many Demon Beasts. A large amount of pyroxene grows in certain areas in the forest thanks to abundance of mana from mana streams littered throughout the woodland.

entries.name: Elior Forest
entries.content: About 100 years before the main story, a village of elves guarded a mysterious seal located in the forest. Ruin was brought to the forest when Pandora and Regulus Corneas led an attack on the forest by bringing the Kurohebi there. Many elves perished, while the remaining elves were frozen by a young Emilia along with the forest itself. The entire southern portion of the forest was destroyed in the battle between Puck and Melakuera.

entries.name: Elior Forest
entries.content: The forest is currently home to the elves who were frozen 100 years ago during the attack on the forest. 49 of them remain frozen as picturesque ice statues. For over 7 years, it had been the home of Emilia and Puck until Emilia left the forest to join the royal selection.

entries.name: frozen stiff thicket
entries.content: The Frozen Stiff Thicket: An area located near the blundering snow road.

entries.name: the garden
entries.content: The Garden is the area which the ice statues of the frozen elves lie. A small stream is located nearby. It is located south of the blundering snow road. Emilia lived close by to this location in a hollow tree.

entries.name: The Gnarled Thicket
entries.content: The Gnarled Thicket: An area deep in the forest surrounded by a dense enclosure of ancient trees with hardly any light exposure. The area is rich in pyroxene.

entries.name: the lake
entries.content: The Lake: A frozen lake dyed in black. The lake was the location where the kurohebi's poison sank to. Once released, the poison manifested itself as black water, and acted with the same destructive intent its owner had.

entries.name: the seal
entries.content: The Seal of Elior Forest is a place in the innermost part of the forest. The surroundings of the seal are surrounded by white trees and the whole area looks like a sacred place. The seal itself takes form of a double-door which stands on its own, not connecting with any buildings or trees. It appears to be made out of wood, it's noted to be very cold to the touch and if rubbed with a hand, one would get the same sensation as rubbing a polished gemstone. There is an old lock located right in the center of the door itself with the keyhole being roughly the same size as young Emilia's hand.

entries.name: the snow blight's domain
entries.content: The Snow Blight's Domain: An area in the northern section of the forest which was ruled by the Snow Blight Demon Beast. After it's defeat, the area was roamed by various Demon Beasts like Guiltylaws.

entries.name: the tree of prayers
entries.content: The Tree of Prayers: An extremely tall, sacred tree which the elves in the elf village would pour their prayers to the divine. Its existence was treasured and revered by everyone in the village. Emilia ended up frozen within its trunk when she froze Elior forest.

entries.name: the twisted forest
entries.content: The Twisted Forest: A woodland area located in the eastern section of the forest.

entries.name: thorny woods
entries.content: Thorny Woods: A woodland area in the north west of the forest covered in ice sheets and teeming with Demon Beasts. This area was heavily affected by the corrosive power of the black water.

entries.name: Elior village
entries.content: Elior villiage: The village which the elves lived in over 100 years ago before Emilia froze the entire forest, along with the elves.

entries.name: Irlam
entries.content: Irlam Geography: There are multiple small bridges and roads that cross Irlam Village, the most notable one is the road to the Mansion of Roswaal. There is also a small bridge which crosses the lake that leads into a forest full of Wolgarms. In order to protect the villagers, they used some magical stones that functioned as a barrier, which prevented any Demon Beasts from trespassing.

entries.name: Western Elior village
entries.content: Western Elior village: A small village on the outskirts of the forest on the west side that Emilia traded with after she was prohibited from entering the eastern village.

entries.name: Irlam
entries.content: The village of Irlam was founded in a field near the Mathers territory, its leader was Milde Irlam for years. Although it appeared to be a peaceful place, it was actually located near a forest full of Wolgarms, causing the villagers to place magical stones around the village, capable of preventing the creatures from approaching.

entries.name: Irlam
entries.content: The Irlam village is located within the territory of Roswaal L Mathers, and is surrounded by multiple forests and large meadows. The village itself exists out of many small houses, with in the center of the village a house bigger than the others, which even carries a red flag.

entries.name: Pleiadas Watchtower
entries.content: The tower is located in the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica's Augria Sand Dunes, and it allows Shaula to keep a lookout for trespassers who were aiming to visit the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine where Satella is currently sealed. Pleiadas Watchtower Appearance: From a distance, behind its defense mechanism known as Sand Time, the watchtower appears as a silhouette that never changes in position, shape or form, no matter how close you try to approach it. After crossing the Sand Time, the tower appears from its exterior as an extremely tall, circular shaped building made of stone. The tower appears to be over a couple of hundred meters in height, and it has a balcony that juts out from one of the floors. Furthermore, a huge door can be seen at the base which leads to the inside of the tower.

entries.name: Alcyone
entries.content: Alcyone, known as the fourth floor, is the first floor from the ground of the Pleiades Watchtower. The floor has a multitude of rooms, which include Shaula's living quarters, a dining hall which has a well in it to draw water, along with the Green Room which is inhabited by a spirit that bestows healing upon its occupants. The balcony that juts out of the Pleiades Watchtower can be accessed from Alcyone. Further to the great spiral staircase that connects it down to Celaeno, two further staircases are in this room. One which leads to Taygeta, and one that leads to Electra.

entries.name: Asterope
entries.content: Asterope, known as the sixth floor, is the basement floor of the Pleiades Watchtower. The room is circular in shape, and quite spacious, approximated to be about 200 or 300 metres in radius. The room's walls are adorned by magical lamps and luminous moss which provide it some illumination. A spiral staircase located on the outer edge of the room leads up to Celaeno.

entries.name: Calaeno
entries.content: Celaeno, known as the fifth floor, is the ground floor of the Pleiades Watchtower. The room is described as a giant hall with no distinguishing features, except for a large door of around about 10 metres in height which leads to the outside of the Watchtower. The door is operated by some sort of mechanical opening system that reacts to touch. Celaeno is connected by the large spiral staircase leading up to Alycone, and one down to Asterope.

entries.name: electra
entries.content: Electra, known as the second floor, is the third floor from the ground of the Pleiades Watchtower. The floor in its initial state only has a sword lying in the middle of its room. Once touched, the second examination of the Pleiades Watchtower commences and Reid Astrea materializes. The challenge on the floor is to make Reid yield a step in combat. Electra can be reached by taking a set of stairs from Alcyone.

entries.name: Pleiades watchtower
entries.content: The tower was designed by Flugel 400 years ago as a means to have a lookout against intruders that seek to reach the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine where Satella is currently sealed. 400 years ago, he commanded Shaula to stay in the tower and kill anyone who approached, unless they were himself. He also put her in charge of upholding the tower's rules. Flugel also designed the examinations inside the tower, which protect the various floors within them.

entries.name: Maia
entries.content: Maia, known as the first floor, is the fourth floor from the ground up, of the Pleiades Watchtower and is right at the top of the tower, situated outside. The floor takes shape of a large circular space, 100 meters in radius, with six pillars placed around the outskirts of the floor and a giant pillar located at the very middle of it. Overseen by Volcanica, who is idly leaning against the giant pillar in the middle, the final examination takes place on this floor. Maia can be reached by taking a set of stairs from Electra, providing the person who does have beaten its challenge.

entries.name: Merope
entries.content: Merope is known as floor zero of the Pleiades Watchtower. The existence of this floor is hidden by Shaula, and she refuses to give information about it.

entries.name: Pleiades watchtower rules
entries.content: There are five rules which challengers must obey whilst in the tower. In the case that a rule is violated, then the Stars Keeper Shaula may turn into her scorpion form which she describes as being a "bloodthirsty killing machine" and eliminate them all. The rules are listed as follows. It is forbidden to leave the tower without completing the trials. It is forbidden to violate the rules of the trials. It is forbidden to disrespect the library. It is forbidden to damage the tower. It is not forbidden to destroy the trials.

entries.name: Pleiades watch tower sand time
entries.content: Sand Time: An invisible force field that twists and bends space, making it impossible to pass through it. It acts as a deterrent for everyone who wants to approach the Pleiadas Watchtower. Despite all that, there is a single flaw in its defenses; a rift, which can only be exploited when a sandstorm occurs. Only then, one can pass through Sand Time and reach the actual tower, provided they can avoid Shaula's Hell's Snipe and countless deadly Demon Beasts residing near the tower's outer walls.

entries.name: Taygeta
entries.content:
Taygeta, known as the third floor, is the second floor from the ground of the Pleiades Watchtower. In its initial state, the room is completely white and only has a single monolith right after the stairs that lead up to the floor. Once touched, the room enters its examination state, and is covered by a series of monoliths which represent stars and their constellations. The first exam takes place on this floor. challengers must touch the brightest of the hero destroyed by Shaula. The correct answer to this challenge is touching the monolith that represents the star Rigel.  Once completed, the room transforms into the Taygeta library, which contains the Books of the Dead that are connected to Od Lagna. until it enters the examination state and it turns into its library form it is supposed to look complete white and bare.
Taygeta library, which contains the books of the dead. Taygeta can be reached by taking a set of stairs from Alcyone.

entries.name: Pleiades watchtower underground door
entries.content: Doors: There are seven in total, with the miasma growing thicker the more doors you open, hinting at the path leading towards the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine where Satella has been residing for the past four centuries. The miasma originates from a door that stands without support in the middle of the above layer. If you try to get through a door you can't open, the door transports you back to the Pleiades Watchtower.

entries.name: Pleiades  watchtower underground
entries.content: Underneath the Tower: An underground area underneath the sand dunes lies beneath the sand dunes, that connects to the Pleiades Watchtower. The area is not illuminated, and it is full of rocky tunnels and caves. There are two layers to this area, and Gabaou infest the area, especially on the left path. In addition to that, a strong miasma emanates throughout the right path; several obstacles that can be described as "Doors" block the path the deeper you traverse through this path.

entries.name: witch cult
entries.content: The Witch Cult, a secretive group worshiping the Witch of Envy, was co-founded by Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti over 400 years ago. Their rumored goal is her resurrection, though some Sin Archbishops deny this. Knights are ordered to kill them on sight. Led by Sin Archbishops, they erased the old Witches of Sin from history 150–250 years ago. About 100 years ago, the cult split into Petelgeuse’s moderate faction and Regulus Corneas' radical faction, clashing at Elior Forest. Members wear black robes with red eye symbols, rarely speak, and obey orders without question. They use suicidal tactics, with expendable members killing themselves to avoid capture. Petelgeuse commanded a larger force, with "fingers" as spare bodies. The cult’s hierarchy has regular Witch Cultists at the bottom and Sin Archbishops at the top, each representing a Deadly Sin except Envy. They follow Gospels that guide them to their desired future. Active worldwide, the cult operates in many countries. The Witch of Vainglory, Pandora, linked their goal to the Elior Forest seal, leading to an attack on the elves before the Permafrost incident.

entries.name: Priestella
entries.content: Priestella is a large, upside-down shaped dome-like walled city, located directly at the Kingdom's border with the Kararagi. Due to Kararagi's influence, the city has notable traces of the so-called Kararagi-style and Jabanees-style architecture and overall culture; inns that are extremely similar to the traditional Japanese-style inns.

entries.name: Priestella city hall
entries.content: Priestella City hall:The City Hall is a tall building in the centre of the city. It houses a large communication device used to broadcast all over the city.

entries.name: Priestella city park
entries.content: Priestella has its very own city park, filled with meticulously maintained flower beds, a large green lawn and at its centre, there's a dazzling water fountain, which could only be described as perfect for its location.

entries.name: council of 10
entries.content:
Priestella is governed over by the Priestellan Council of Ten, a group of ten powerful and wealthy individuals, with Kiritaka Muse acting as their leader of sorts.
Council of Ten Members: Darts, Kiritaka Muse, Liliana Masquerade, Garek Thompson, Reala Thompson, Rafiel Thompson, Muslan Kallard, Ina Kallard, Lusbel Kallard, Tina.

entries.name: Priestella
entries.content: Priestella was built approximately four centuries ago, using four centuries old combination of technologies. Furthermore, the city was said to have been build by non other than Hoshin of the Wilderness, and throughout history, the city itself was a cause of considerable territorial disputes between the two nations, though it currently belongs to the Lugnica. It was built as a trap mechanism for extremely dangerous individuals and creatures. The control towers were designed so that they could flood the entire city when the flood gates are all released. This mechanism was successfully used in the past to kill Typhon.

entries.name: Control Towers
entries.content: The Four Control Towers: At all four sides of the city–north, south, west and east–there lies one massive stone tower. As mentioned above, the towers themselves are complex metias housing water magic crystals, and server as regulators of the water channels' flow and amount of water. Furthermore, they server as the ultimate trap mechanism–from there, one can open up the flood gates and flood the entire city.

entries.name: great temple
entries.content: The Great Temple: A temple located underneath Priestella, where the Witch of Pride's remains are said to be kept. It can be accessed through a secret door in the area under the canals, that masks a trapdoor. The Temple is protected by a Guardian, with a grotesque appearance. It's described to not be a Demon Beast, and to have an appearance that looked like it had been formed by a lot of rats coming together, with heads coming out of its torso.

entries.name: Tigracy River,Tigracy Bridge
entries.content: Tigracy Bridge: A stone bridge that sits over the Tigracy River on the Lugnican side which leads to the front gates of Priestella.

entries.name: Time Towers
entries.content: Time Towers: All across Priestella, several Time Towers can be found scattered around. These Time Towers are usually built out of stone and are rather tall, with a tall spire at its peak. At its upper portion, one can see a magic crystal clock, which works similarly to normal clocks from Earth. In truth, the point of Time Towers are to help people track the time of day.

entries.name: Sanctuary
entries.content: The Sanctuary: A poor village located within Roswaal's territory which has been taken care of by the various Mathers over the years. The village itself is a group of buildings located in a clearing within the forest and only halves live there. It is surrounded by a short fence with an old stone gate at the entrance. Currently abandoned. The Sanctuary's original purpose was to keep the Warlock of Melancholy away from Echidna.

entries.name: Sanctuary
entries.content: Sanctuary History: As Echidna was being pursued by Hector, she called a group of Demi-humans to take refuge in a clearing, only to lock them up, creating a barrier with the help of Ryuzu Meyer. Eventually, she created copies of Ryuzu to experiment with immortality, however, Echidna soon got sealed by Volcanica. After this, the copies of Ryuzu administered the Sanctuary, and the Roswaal family chose to protect the cemetery for several generations.

entries.name: Sanctuary
entries.content: Citizens: Ryuzu Meyer (copy) (elder), Garfiel Tinsel, numerous other Demi-Humans.

entries.name: Santuary,sanctuary barrier
entries.content: Sanctuary Barrier: A barrier created by Echidna that prevents halves from going through it. Any halves that come close to it start to lose consciousness and feel as if their existence is being disturbed. Even if someone takes an unconscious half that has crossed the barrier, they will never awake outside the barrier as their spirit is trapped within it. The barrier checks the blood of those that go near it and only affects those it clearly determines as half-bloods. It also causes those who are not permitted to enter the Sanctuary to get lost.

entries.name: Residency Area,Sanctuary
entries.content: Residency Area: The place where denizens of Sanctuary live. The buildings are largely dilapidated which give the whole area a run-down look. There is farmland for growing some crops, but residents otherwise rely on Roswaal for gathering and delivering necessities from the outside.

entries.name: Labratory,Sanctuary
entries.content: Laboratory: A strange white building that belonged to Echidna, situated away from the village area of Sanctuary and deeper into the forest. It is made of a strange material that does not wear or tear from the elements and an odd smell exudes from the structure.

entries.name: Sanctuary,Echidna's Tomb
entries.content: Echidna's Tomb: Echidna's final resting place and where the trials needed to lift the barrier are conducted at night. During the day, miasma bars entry to anyone except those qualified to take her trials.

entries.name: magic types,magic elements,categories of magic
entries.content: Magic is made up of six elements; Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Yin, and Yang. It is further classified into four categories; Fire element that covers temperature, Water element that covers life and healing, Wind element that functions outside of the bodies of living things, and Earth element that functions inside of the bodies of living things. Yin spells cover debuffs while Yang spells cover buffs.

entries.name: covenant
entries.content: Covenants: Oaths formed between entire bloodlines, rather than just specific individuals, such as the one between the Kingdom of Lugnica's late Royal Family and the Divine Dragon, which vows the Dragon to aid the Kingdom when in need. Covenants are usually long-lasting (for several generations).

entries.name: Spirit,Magic
entries.content: Generally, there are two types of primary casters in the world: Magic Users draw on their internal mana through their mana gates, and Spirit Users which use the mana in the atmosphere with the aid of spirits to process spells directly. Spirits can also act as pseudo mana gates for their contractors if they are lacking the means to use magic on their own. Both types of casters are incredibly rare, magic is not an every day occurance.

entries.name: Mana
entries.content: Mana: Colourless supernatural energy that exists in the atmosphere, which can be found basically everywhere. When magic is being processed, a person’s innate attitude will charge the mana particles to their specific "element", which briefly manifests as formless spell-form before taking shape of the spell chosen. When a person casts magic, they will experience brief physical and mental fatigue which results in sudden weakness if they are not used to expelling magic or if they overcast beyond their capacity. Mana itself originates from the Od Laguna.

entries.name: od
entries.content: Od: Life energy that dwells inside of living being from birth which is synonymous with the soul, making it opposite to mana. Varies in quantity and size which represents the lifespan of the individual. Acts as a vessel for storing mana that flows through gate from environment, so having large capacity is especially beneficial to those who can use magic. Od can be used in place of mana, however, using Od is like using your own lifespan. In case the user runs out of Od, they won't die, but they won't be themselves anymore.

entries.name: od laguna
entries.content: Od Lagna is a vast storage of mana located at the origin of the world itself, or in other words, at the world's core. It is where all mana comes from in the world, and eventually goes back to. No one knows where it is located. It has no will of it's own. Those who stumble over prohibited arts have their spirits destroyed by simply looking at it. Some speculate that it is the world's will and gives Divine Protections to people.

entries.name: mana gate
entries.content: Mana Gate: An invisible portal-like apparatus that exists in every living thing. Allows mana to pass through the body and be stored in the Od. Whether one can use magic or not entirely depends on its condition; be it either fully or partly open. Most people only have partly functioning gates so magic is out of reach to them. In addition, there are some with a defective gate that keeps them from releasing mana at all. Overcasting magic can also lead to damaging the gate, and then the permanent loss of magic if the user continues to do so without treatment.

entries.name: Defective Gate
entries.content: Defective Gate: Medical term for individuals whose Mana Gate cannot perform the normal circulation process of either absorbing or expelling mana. If the former occurs that person cannot use magic unless they expend their Od. If its the latter, then they are at risk of "Mana Poisoning".

entries.name: Od Laguna,Hall of Memories
entries.content: Hall of Memories: Endless white space within Od Laguna, where souls of the dead get filtered of their impurities, or in other words, memories of its previous life. Those memories are then recorded & preserved by turning them into Books of the Dead, which are stored in Pleiades Watchtower's library.

entries.name: Fura,casting,Huma,Yiwald,Goa,Incantations,Dona,Shamak
entries.content: magic words are basically Incantations: Goa for fire, Huma for water, Fura for wind, Dona for earth, Shamak for Yin, and Jiwald for Yang. The strength of spells starts from the original incantation and increases by adding El, Ul, or Al. Although incantations are generally used to cast spells, if the user is experienced enough they can cast without saying anything.

entries.name: Lagmite
entries.content: Lagmite: Created when atmospheric mana crystallizes under specific conditions over a period of time. Magic crystals are large type of mana stones that grow over a significant amount of time and have no impurities, but very few currently exist. They come in six elements and serve many practical functions in society. Living beings with a gate can come in contact and use them. The individual does not need to be able to use magic themselves to make use of them. Crystals in raw form are volatile and need to be handled with care otherwise will unleash the mana stored within for explosive effects.

entries.name: Magic Release Period
entries.content: Magic Release Period: Phenomenon that occurs to individuals and beings who possess potent magical power, powerful gates and Od that allow them to draw-in and store more mana than they let out. It happens when a magic user doesn't maintain a proper release cycle to let off excess mana from their Od which causes it to overflow from beyond their bodies. It can have drastic effects on the person such as mana poisoning, and it can even affect the environment. The mana will eventually burst out of and damage their gate if it's not forcibly released.

entries.name: Magic Books
entries.content: Magic Books: Can only be read by individuals who are well versed in magic, and can utilize mana. The books look plain on the outside and have blank pages, however, if the reader concentrates, letters made out of mana appear, allowing the holder of the book to read it.

entries.name: Mana Boost
entries.content: Mana Boost: Normal people can utilize mana for their own benefits. Different warriors, knights, swordsmen and the like. By subconsciously using their own mana and letting it flow through their body, they imbue themselves with magic-like properties, such as enhanced speed, agility, reflexes, strength and healing. Naturally, these boosts aren't as strong as Yang Magic or Spirit-given boosts, but are none the less capable.

entries.name: Mana Poisoning
entries.content: Mana Poisoning: State in which an individual continues to absorb an excess amount of mana beyond their Od's capacity, but is incapable of releasing it, which will eventually destroy their Od and kill them. Improperly configured or defective gates are the common cause of this. Individuals in this status who don't receive constant treatment are often very sick.

entries.name: Oaths
entries.content: Oaths: There exist concepts known as contracts that can either be magically binding or honour-binding. They are collectively known as oaths, which are broken down into three main categories; Pacts/Contracts, Covenants, and Vows.

entries.name: Pacts,contracts
entries.content: Pacts/Contracts: Two parties can form oaths, which are usually made between spirit-sensitive humans or Demi-Humans, and Spirits. By doing this, the formerly mentioned parties form a symbiotic relationship with Spirits, and become what is known as a Spirit Art Users.

entries.name: lagmite,Pyroxene
entries.content: Pyroxene Crystal: Rare colorless type of lagmite crystal that unlike normal mana crystals is very small. They are only found in places with high density of mana. The crystal holds incredible powers such as being able to store souls, spirits and fragments of one's Od. It can be used as a means of containing and controlling magical algorithms that generate spells. Often functions as a key for people to pass into places that are otherwise very difficult or impossible due to powerful barriers.

entries.name: Witch's Miasma
entries.content: Witch's Miasma: Invisible contamination mana that exudes from those who hold the power of witches or are connected to them. This miasma can be sensed by certain individuals who are sensitive to it. Normally harmless, but in high density will start having negative effects on all things; living beings with gates will be driven into madness, food will be polluted and go on to corrupt those who eat it. Demon Beasts are attracted to those who give it off and will deliberately attack them as well as grow stronger in places where it is very prevalent.

entries.name: Absolute Zero
entries.content: Absolute Zero: The user creates a vacuum in an area, by freezing the atmosphere to an absurd degree. By doing so, even time will freeze inside of that vacuum and no one is capable of escaping it unharmed. The ability is noted to be Emilia's absolute trump card and is by far her most powerful ability in her arsenal.

entries.name: Akra
entries.content: Akra: The user produces pale colored light around the target that envelops them in a veil of golden light. The veil allows the target to carry things with ease.

entries.name: Julius,Al Clarista
entries.content: Al Clarista: Julius imbues his sword with sixfold magic, cladding the blade in a rainbow hue. When it this state, his sword is capable of cutting through pretty much everything. When Julius pierces his opponent, he scorches away their very soul, delivering a fatal wound.

entries.name: Julius,Al Clauzeria
entries.content: Al Clauzeria: Julius' spirits from a circle around the the tip of his sword which envelopes the surrounding with a pure white light that unleashes a blow that aims to pierce an opponent. When making contact with a solid surface, the light expands in a circular shape, creating an expanding rainbow dome that scorches away everything in its path.

entries.name: Al Cravel,Julius
entries.content: Al Cranvel: Julius calls upon the power of his newly-bloomed Spirits and clads himself in their sixfold power, greatly increasing his speed and overall power while also appearing as if his entire body has been swallowed by a rainbow. This skill is noted to be Julius' ultimate technique.

entries.name: Al Dona
entries.content: Al Dona: The user summons forth an extremely devastating explosion of sediment flying towards its targets with speeds almost impossible to evade. The force of the attack is enough to pulverise large rocks and trees. If caught in the attack, one barely has any chances of escaping with their life.

entries.name: Al Fura
entries.content: Al Fura: The user unleashes an extremely devastating torrent of wind blades that destroy everything and everyone in its path. The unleashed wind blades are described as having the force of a gigantic dragon and the sharpness of a treasured sword. People who are hit with this spell immediately have their eardrums destroyed, their entire bodies slashed to pieces and at the end, not even a pool of blood is left of them.

entries.name: Ai goa
entries.content: Al Goa: The user lets loose a massive fireball, scorching away everything in its path. The bigger the caster's skill, the hotter and bigger the fireball.

entries.name: Al Huma
entries.content: Al Huma: The user creates a sharp spear of ice. The user's skill determines the length of the spear.

entries.name: Al Jiwald
entries.content: Al Jiwald is the ultimate form of Jiwald. The user fires a destructive ray of heat from their palm that annihilates everything in its path and is extremely hard to block or counter.

entries.name: Al Shamak
entries.content: Al Shamak is a spell capable of sending its target to a different dimension. It is borderline impossible for a living being to come back from the dimension they were teleported to.

entries.name: Al Shario
entries.content: Al Shario: The user topples the very stars from the sky, sending them hurling towards her enemies, causing unimaginable devastation. The projectiles are mentioned to be nigh impossible to evade.

entries.name: dona
entries.content: Dona: The user summons one earth wall from the ground. It is typically used for defence, but it can be applied for offense and evasive movement.

entries.name: door crossing
entries.content: Door Crossing: Beatrice can connect the door of the library to any door she wishes to, as long as she's been to that designated location. She can also use a limited version of Door Crossing to teleport things or people.

entries.name: duplication magic
entries.content: Duplication Magic: Magic that can copy one thing into two. Not that many people can use it. If used on a living thing, it can only copy its skin, but if it's used on something like food it's thought to be able to copy it without any problems. However, both the original and the copy degrade slightly after use.

entries.name: eI dona
entries.content: El Dona: The user conjures a swarm of earth mana and pinpoints it at a target, usually channelled through a medium, which then causes the effected area to burst into spikes from the centre, expanding outwards.

entries.name: El Fura
entries.content: El Fura: The user unleashes a blade of wind, travelling at maximum velocity. It was noted that the attack couldn't be physically countered.

entries.name: El Huma
entries.content: El Huma: The user forms and shoots multitudes of ice spears from their hands which easily pierces through and crushes flesh that vanish a moment afterwards.

entries.name: El Jiwald
entries.content: El Jiwald: The user fires several rays from their fingers which are then brought down in a claw-like motion.

entries.name: El Minya
entries.content: El Minya: The spell works exactly the same as normal Minya, only changing the amount of stakes shot to 40.

entries.name: El Shamak
entries.content: El Shamak is the name of a spell that makes The target become unable to control their bodies while under its effects.

entries.name: El Vita
entries.content: El Vita: Grants extra mass to the object of casting, greatly amplifying its weight.

entries.name: Fell Goa,Julius
entries.content: Fell Goa: Julius calls on La to produce a powerful magical firestorm, combining both Fire and Wind Magic.

entries.name: flying magic
entries.content: Flying Magic: This spell allows the user to float or fly in the sky. Combination of Wind, Fire, and Earth Magic.

entries.name: fura
entries.content: Fura: The user shoots wind slashes with a super high speed that can cut through wood, stone & flesh with ease.

entries.name: goa
entries.content: Goa: The user manifests a blaze of fire to incinerate their foes.

entries.name: healing magic
entries.content: Healing Magic: The user summons water mana to heal the wounds of themselves and other, however, Healing Magic only affects physical damage. The spell's power varies by the skill and talent of the individual or partially that of spirit if the caster is using the spell through Spirit Arts. it works by stimulating someone's natural healing ability so it is not regeneration. healing magic is not supposed to be able to heal Mana Gates. If an individual has no regard for human life, they're unable to cast Healing Magic.

entries.name: huma
entries.content: Huma: The user creates a shining water barrier that blocks other projectiles and sorts of magic. However, if the incoming magic is stronger than the shield it will get through it and cause damage to the user.

entries.name: Jiwald
entries.content: Jiwald: User fires heat rays from their fingers.

entries.name: Immortal King's Sacrament
entries.content: The Sacrament of the Immortal King is an ancient, currently incomplete spell that reanimates corpses to serve as soulless "corpse soldiers," which decompose over time. Originally believed to fully revive the dead, the complete method was lost, leaving only a fragment preserved in an heirloom book. Casting requires a rare natural affinity, and even then, only limited effects are possible. Combining the spell with other tools or remains can enhance its effects, such as increasing the size of reanimated bodies. only incomplete incantations are known of this powerful water magic spell. it is also called Immortal King's Sacrament sometimes. an unnamed witch is believed to have invented the spell to resurrect someone. though the dead person still has to have their soul in their body which limits how long you can wait to use the sacrament on someone.

entries.name: Minya
entries.content: Minya: Magic that creates stakes made of crystallized mana covered with light purple flames. They are strong enough to penetrate defenses. Any stakes in the air explode and release smaller stakes that fly in all directions which then rips targets apart.

entries.name: Murak
entries.content: Murak: The user reduces the effects of gravity. Just by lightly pushing yourself off the ground, a person can jump as if they had springs. If the user wishes to, it can also be used to fly, although the user will get blown around by the wind like a leaf, but they won't flip around in mid-air.

entries.name: nect
entries.content: Nect: A high level magic that enables people to share senses within the effect area by connecting their gates. It is considered to be difficult to use, however two people can use it by pairing Yin and Yang Magic together and tuning the interference of mana between people. If it is too weak the thoughts won't get through, yet if it's too strong people won't know where the line between them and other people begin.

entries.name: One Blow One Hundred Felled
entries.content: One Blow, One Hundred Felled: Crusch combines her Divine Protection of Wind Indication and Wind Magic to unleash a sword strike that enables her to cut anything within her range of vision with an invisible blade. The attack is sharp enough to slash through the Hakugei's thick hide, toppling the Demon Beast.

entries.name: Restoration Magic
entries.content: Restoration Magic: A type of Yang magic that can recover objects to their original state. It's mainly used by specialists who have the innate affinity for Yang so not that many people can use it.

entries.name: Rewriting Magic
entries.content: Rewriting Magic: The user can rewrite the spell's composition and disassemble the spell into mana, absorbing it through their own gate. The only condition to successfully pull off Rewriting Magic is making physical contact with the spell itself.

entries.name: shamak
entries.content:
Shamak is the name of a spell that makes The target become unable to sense where they are, however they can still feel the ground and sense what's happening to their body.

A high-grade Shamak can rend space together and achieve an effect similar to teleportation.

entries.name: Soul Transference
entries.content: Soul Transference: The user can transfer their soul into a vessel by "pushing out" the body's original soul. By doing so, the user can in theory achieve immortality. The spell was originally devised by the Witch of Greed. Normally, in order for the spell to work, one must transfer their soul into a body that's related to the user by blood, however, Echidna found a way to somewhat bypass that obstacle.

entries.name: ui dona
entries.content: Ul Dona: The user lifts thick walls of earth around themselves self in a shape of a dome. The walls are thick and strong enough to provide basic cover, however, any stronger explosive attack will destroy the walls.

entries.name: Ul Goa
entries.content: Ul Goa: The user fires a large amount of powerful fire bullets. A powerful flame scatters when the bullets land.

entries.name: Ul Minya
entries.content: Ul Minya: The user creates a purple ring of light around the target that shrinks and binds the target, subsequently spreading across their body. Once the target is bound, a huge purple blue light appears above the target to destroy them. The effect is currently unknown as Beatrice's attempt was stopped partway through.

entries.name: Ul Shamak
entries.content: Ul Shamak covers the area in darkness like Shamak except the opponent can't tell anything while under its effect, such as where they are sitting or standing. Those affected by it can be snapped out of its effects.

entries.name: Ul Fura
entries.content: Ul Fura: The chant is described to rewrite the world around the user, transforming the air around them into blades of wind which are sent hurling towards the caster's enemies. The blades travel sporadically and without a set course, turning their target into minced meat.

entries.name: Ul Huma
entries.content: Ul Huma: The user summons massive ice pillars from the ground that crash into their target.

entries.name: vita
entries.content: Vita: The user casts this spell to amplify the effects of gravity, making an object heavier.

entries.name: weather changing magic
entries.content: Weather Changing Magic: A spell that allows the caster to freely change the weather with the usage of mana. The spell itself is extremely complex and requires a great deal of concentration and preparation.

entries.name: council  of elders
entries.content: Council of Elders: An advisory board that supports Lugnica's ruler comprised of accomplished and distinguished people. They are currently administrating the country in place of a king until the Royal Selection is over. The amount of members is not known.

entries.name: Black Silver Coin
entries.content: Black Silver Coin: An organization that is based in the black society of Flanders. It is rumored that they deal with items related to the Witches.

entries.name: Flower Prison Garden
entries.content: Flower Prison Garden: One of the known factions of the Three Heads run by Toto. Known to have a very bad relationship with The Libra. They specialize in prostitution.

entries.name: Kingdom Knights,guards
entries.content: Kingdom Knights: Within the Royal Army, whose total number is around 2000 strong. They are a class of dragon-mounted cavalry riders and form the professional core of the Armed Forces. The Knights corps are typically made up of children of nobility and landholders, and as a result, the Kingdom Knights presumably have an inclusive in-group court culture that follows strict chivalric principles. Being entwined with the history of the country, its monarchy, and its politics, the Kingdom Knights hold considerable prestige and influence in the Lugnian government.

entries.name: royal guard
entries.content: Royal Guard: Elite group dedicated solely to the security and wellbeing of the Royal Family. A group that anyone involved with the Kingdom Knights dreams of entering. They traditionally are tasked with protecting the king and the members of the royal family. All members of the Royal Guard are handpicked by the Captain Marcos and wear a white cape.

entries.name: the golden beetle
entries.content: The Golden Beetle: Last known faction of the Three Heads. A Money lender who deals with businesses in the black society of Flanders. It is controlled by Helain Gatness.

entries.name: the libra
entries.content: The Libra: A faction that's part of the Three Heads, led by Manfred Madison also known as "The Tattooed Face" and are in charge with gambling. The Libra also seem to revere the Witch of Pride.

entries.name: Lugnica Army,Royal Army
entries.content: The Royal Army: Tasked with defending the kingdom from dangers, from Demon Beasts to the Demi-Humans to the Vollachia Empire. Many aspects of the army are unknown. It can be presumed that it is very similar in nature to a typical fantasy army, with sword-wielding infantry, magic casters, and armored knights all marching alongside. However, despite the medieval nature of the military, the Lugnican army is able to field magic artillery resembling Maser cannons.

entries.name: the 3 heads
entries.content: The Three Heads: A term used for the three most powerful groups of Flanders underground society known as the black society.

entries.name: Zellgef Squadron
entries.content: Zellgef Squadron: One of the most renowned military units in Lugnica, distinguishing itself during the Demi-Human War. The unit saw combat in most of the major battles. It was also this group that directly accompanied the former Sword Saint, Theresia van Astrea.

entries.name: dragon sword reid
entries.content: Dragon Sword Reid: The strongest of the Ten Swords of Power. The Sword has been passed down through generations ever since the days of the first Sword Saint, Reid Astrea. It can only be unsheathed by a Sword Saint, though most Sword Saints have never gotten an opportunity to use it, let alone see the gleaming blade of the Dragon Sword. The most beautiful blade known to man. The blade is abnormally sharp and nigh unbreakable, capable of destroying the world and cutting through space and mana itself.

entries.name: Sword Saint
entries.content: Sword Saints: Regarded as the Kingdom's greatest weapons and are only called in action when the situation is at the most desperate. Many Astreas and Sword Saints have been killed in action in service of the kingdom, in most recent memory being Theresia van Astrea, who was lost in the disastrous First Great Expedition. The current generation's Sword Saint is Reinhard van Astrea.

entries.name: House of Astrea
entries.content: The House of Astrea: One of the most acclaimed Houses in the Lugnica. 400 years ago, Reid Astrea, the forerunner of the Astrea bloodline, aided in defeating and sealing the Witch of Envy. Ever since then, one member per generation has been chosen as the next Sword Saint; a knight who inherits the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, which can only be inherited by a member of the Astrea family. Some members of the household have heavily involved themselves in the ongoing Royal Elections.

entries.name: Karsten Dragon Crest
entries.content: Karsten Dragon Crest: After the covenant with the dragon was made, the old crest, the Lion Crest, gave way to the new crest; that of the dragon. The gift of the Lion Crest to the Karsten house is a consistent reminder of the House's greatest accomplishment, that being its many centuries of loyalty to the crown, and is pridefully displayed in all manners by its members and associates.

entries.name: Karsten Villa
entries.content: Karsten Villa: Located within the Nobles' District in the Capital, the one villa that stands above every other is in possession of non other than the Karsten family. Despite it being as luxurious and extravagant as the main Mathers domain, it is only used when the House's patriarch has important business in the Capital. In that case, it is large enough to act as a military base. Its estate front lawn itself is vast in size, about to field a makeshift camp and hospital.

entries.name: Karsten Wealth
entries.content: Karsten Wealth: As expected of a house so highly regarded, the Karsten family is fabulously wealthy as well; able to sport the finest estates in some of the best lands in the kingdom.

entries.name: curse
entries.content: Curses: Subcategory of spiritual and magical arts originating from Gusteko. Most notable traits about curses are they cannot be defended against once activated and they are most effective class of magic when it comes to killing. Physical contract between caster and target is mandatory for curses to work. Unlike other normal magic, Curses are only limited to taking lives and have no other application in society beyond that. This caused the practice to become taboo leading it to fall out of favor among mainstream Magicians.

entries.name: magic circle
entries.content: Magic Circle: Ancient geometric algorithm used to perform complex spells and rituals that can be drawn on the earth or a living being. These can produce great kinds of effects such as large-scale magic that completely alters the state of a battlefield, imbuing an individual with extreme power, or even temporarily cutting off Divine Protections.

entries.name: spirit eater
entries.content: Spirit Eater: People who can eat and absorb spirits of all kinds, which in turn allows them to use those spirits' abilities until they digest it. A downside to this ability is high susceptibility to mana poisoning. By being exposed to larger quantities of mana, Spirit Eaters get sick way more easily than normal people.

entries.name: spirit user
entries.content: Spirit user: People who are contracted with Spirits, and use them in various situations. There are three different classes of spirits; Lesser spirits, Quasi spirits, and Spirits. There are also man made spirits known as Artificial Spirits which were created by the witch Echidna. Unlike Magic users, Spirit Users gather mana from outside their body. The only downside to Spirit Users is that the greatest amount of mana they can use at one time, is dictated by their contracted spirit. The greater the spirit's capacity for mana, the bigger the spells its contractor can cast.

entries.name: divine protection
entries.content: Divine Protections: Blessings given to people at birth by the Od Laguna. Some races have an inherent Divine Protection. Most people are born without any Divine Protection, and those who are born with it know of their own Divine Protection without being told. Two Divine Protections that work against each other will cancel each other out. Incompatible with Witch Factors. Have the potential for individual variations and growths.

entries.name: divine protection holders
entries.content: Ratio of Divine Protection holders: 1 in 100 for useless ones, 1 in 1,000 for useful ones, 1 in 10,000 for somewhat rare ones, 1 in 100,000 for really useful ones, 1 in 1,000,000 for unique ones, 1 in 10,000,000 for more than one, and the existence of those with more than one Divine Protection are considered to be strange.

entries.name: boar tribe
entries.content: Boar Tribe: A rare Demi-human race nearly wiped out during the Demi-human War by the Sword Saint. About the same size as Wolfin. They have the head of a boar with human physique.

entries.name: dwarf
entries.content: The Dwarf Tribe are a common type of Demi-human that are shorter than normal humans.

entries.name: elves
entries.content: Elf: A race of Demi-humans known for their longevity and beauty. Elves look like a Human with have Leaf-shaped ears. They are hairless everywhere except hair on the head like Humans, with Eyebrows and Eyelashes. Because of the Witch of Envy, Elves are also the target of prejudice from others.

entries.name: evil eye tribe
entries.content: Evil Eye Tribe: Type of Demi-Humans that were wiped out by the Empire. There were originally not that many of them and they possessed the ability to see invisible things and interfere with the minds of others with their eyes. Rumors say that there are still living members existing.

entries.name: giant
entries.content: Giant: Demi-human race of massive people with tremendous strength and a lifespan of around 150 years. They fought in various places during wartime and because of that their numbers had dwindled. The only Giant in the royal capital is Rom. Sekhmet killed almost all Giants.

entries.name: Sudrak
entries.content: Sudrak Tribe: A purely female born race deep in the Buddheim Jungle, known for being descendants of war gods who lived in the jungle for hundreds of years. They reproduce with men from outside. Members are dark skinned and have pitch black hair. As expected from a warrior clan, they mastered the art of guerrilla warfare using terrain to their favour, dispatching targets with poisonous arrows, deadly precision and devastating traps.

entries.name: Apostle of Greed
entries.content: Apostle of Greed: A term and position given to those who have gained Echidna's favor. It grants them the Command Authority which forces compulsory obedience from all replicas of Ryuzu.

entries.name: corpse soldier
entries.content: Corpse Soldier: A name for a type of undead that retains some measure of their marital ability after death. When destroyed, the magic will be released and the victims will momentary returned to the state they were right before their deaths but breakdown into ash right after. Capella likes to use the bodies of people her opponents used to love in order to sadistically toy with her opponents emotions.

entries.name: Dem-Beast
entries.content: Demi-Beast: A kind of species that appeared after the flooding of Priestella. Interestingly enough, they are not related to Demon Beasts. The beasts are described to be a cross between steel and flesh, having weapons like axes, spears, and such protruding from their body. Most are blind and lack certain body parts. The beasts are Capella's creations, of which, she made from corpses.

entries.name: demon beast
entries.content: Demon Beasts: A general name for any number of organisms that are able to sustain themselves off mana. They are rumored to have been created by a Witch of Envy with the purpose of wiping out humanity. Demon Beasts that have their horns broken follow whoever broke it.

entries.name: dragon
entries.content: Dragons: In the days of the Witches, Dragons freely roamed the world in numbers. They lived in flocks everywhere around the world, and formed smaller communities or factions, which were led by their chosen Dragon representatives, who were renowned around the world. their species is nearly extinct. They were capable of speech and were rather intelligent beings. They have large lizard-like bodies and sport a pair of wings, though there were instances of Dragons with two pairs of wings.

entries.name: Ground dragon,Earth Dragon
entries.content: Earth Dragon: Dragons created by Volcanica. Much like horses on earth, these wingless, land-based dragons are often domesticated to be used in menial labors such as transport or in warfare. They have varied body types and colours to suit different terrains, environmental conditions and jobs which makes them excellent to work with. All Earth Dragons are born with Wind Evasion, a species-based Divine Protection.

entries.name: Royal Selection,Royal Candidate
entries.content: Royal Selection: An election to decide on who will become the 42nd King of Lugnica. The elections span for three years until the same day, which falls on the month before the ritual to form a new contract between Volcanica and the chosen candidate. The five candidates are Emilia, Crusch Karsten, Anastasia Hoshin, Priscilla Barielle, and Felt, all of whom were chosen by the Dragon Insignias.

entries.name: Water Dragib
entries.content: Water Dragon: A lesser species of dragon. They are aquatic creatures, with long serpentine bodies, with short stubby limbs. They have blue, slippery skin and have a head that resembles a dragon's. Their mouths are crowded by sharp fangs, and catfish-like whiskers extend from its snout.
