His striking looks, inherited from his father Heinkel and inhumanly beautiful mother Louanna Astrea, include a sharp jawline, defined cheekbones, and a regal air. He wears a black shirt, white trousers with lilac cuffs, black gloves and shoes, and a double-breasted white coat with lilac lining and the Astrea crest on the left sleeve. He carries the Dragon Sword Reid on a black belt, exuding gallantry and an approachable charm.
Reinhard embodies chivalry, fairness, and respect, treating everyone with unwavering courtesy. As the Sword Saint, he avoids unnecessary violence, using his sword only when absolutely required, while his presence alone often deters threats. Despite his immense power, he values compassion and dislikes being seen as dangerous. Reinhard is strict yet caring, guiding those around him with patience and enduring criticism with a calm demeanor. He respects all individuals, opposes prejudice, and always seeks peaceful solutions, earning widespread trust and admiration.

entries.name: Reinhard van Astrea history
entries.content: Reinhard, son of Heinkel and Louanna Astrea, was loved by all and called "a child loved by the world." At two, his mother fell into a Sleeping Beauty state, deeply affecting the family. At five, Reinhard inherited the title of Sword Saint after his grandmother Theresia's death, causing family strife. His father became distant, and Wilhelm blamed him for Theresia's passing. By age eight, Reinhard's immense power led to the creation of the "Reinhard Law," restricting his movements as a perceived national threat. At 14, he joined the Royal Guard, becoming the Kingdom's strongest weapon and a symbol of its might.

entries.name: Reinhard van Astrea powers
entries.content: Reinhard van Astrea possesses a wide range of Divine Protections, granting him superhuman speed, agility, reflexes, and the ability to master any weapon. His power also includes magic resistance, enhanced physical strength, and the ability to absorb mana. As the Sword Saint, his swordsmanship is unparalleled, anticipating and countering attacks with ease. He wields the Dragon Sword Reid, which only unsheathes for worthy opponents. Despite his immense abilities, he cannot obtain Divine Protections already held by others, making him reliant on his blessings for his power.

entries.name: water element
entries.content: water magic also covers healing and life.

entries.name: Fire element
entries.content: Fire magic also covers temperature.

entries.name: wind element
entries.content: wind magic also covers controlling what happens outside the bodies of living things.

entries.name: earth element
entries.content: earth magic covers functions inside the the bodies of living things.

entries.name: yin element
entries.content: yin magic covers debuffs

entries.name: yang element
entries.content: yang magic covers buffs.

entries.name: ram relationship with Roswaal
entries.content: Roswaal, guided by his Book of Wisdom, chose not to prevent the Witch Cult's attack on Ram's village, despite knowing it in advance which Ram does not know about. Instead, he saved Ram and Rem, raising them with care and trust. Over time, Ram developed love and affection for Roswaal.

entries.name: rem relationship with Roswaal
entries.content: Roswaal took Rem and Ram under his care, deeply caring for them. Unlike Ram, Rem's loyalty to Roswaal is more out of necessity, tied to her desire to protect Ram. Roswaal also values Rem for her ability to act as Ram's horn, enabling ram to use her full power when the time comes. Rem is unaware Roswaal knew of the attack on her village but chose not to prevent it.

entries.name: Minerva powers
entries.content: Minerva's Authority of Wrath allowed her to heal anyone by striking them, draining mana from the world to rewrite cause and effect. Her attacks, even with projectiles, could only heal, not harm, though indirect environmental damage could still hurt others. Her ability caused unintended natural disasters by disrupting the world's mana, often leading to more harm than good. It only worked on physical wounds, unable to cure diseases, curses, aging, or other non-injury conditions.

entries.name: Sekhmet
entries.content:
Sekhmet was a pale, languid woman in her mid-twenties with unkempt magenta hair reaching her toes. She wore a sultry black outfit that highlighted her voluptuous figure, and her face appeared debilitated and apathetic. Sekhmet also does NOT smell good.
Sekhmet, the Witch of Sloth, was profoundly lazy, finding even breathing tiresome. Despite her gloom, she was mature, philosophical, and neutral in disputes, aiding those she deemed right.

entries.name: Sekhmet history
entries.content: Sekhmet, born to the Giant clan, was abandoned for failing their expectations. Captured by men after years in the mountains, she gained knowledge and emotions but killed them out of misunderstood gratitude, later burying them. She returned to her homeland, killing her clan in revenge, then found peace alone. Over 400 years ago, Sekhmet drove Dragons beyond the Great Waterfall for rest but ultimately fell from it in battle with Volcanica, dying ironically.

entries.name: Sekhmet power
entries.content: Sekhmet's Authority of Sloth allowed her to manipulate an invisible force, far superior in speed, range, and power to her successor's version. This force, likely hand-shaped, could crush or restrain targets effortlessly. Sekhmet possessed immense power, capable of overwhelming all Witches of Sin except Satella within a minute and holding her own against even the Divine Dragon.

entries.name: pandora
entries.content:
Pandora appears as a young woman with a delicate body, long platinum hair glowing like sunlight, and slit-pupiled deep blue eyes framed by long lashes. Her inhuman beauty, radiating perfection and terror, is enough to make onlookers tremble. She wears a simple white poncho-like gown with blue stitching and a matching ribbon in her hair. Barefoot, she exudes an aura of importance, and her voice enchants, binding body and soul.
Pandora is dignified and calm, masking a selfish, sociopathic nature. She manipulates others, shows no remorse for causing pain or chaos, and views people as pawns rather than equals. Despite her cruelty, she remains composed, never expressing anger, even when opposed.

entries.name: pandora history
entries.content:
Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory, absorbed the Witch Factor of Vainglory, granting her the Authority of Vainglory and a position among the Witches of Sin. Unlike others, she roamed freely after the Witch of Envy's calamity, spreading chaos for unknown reasons. Associated with the Witch Cult, she outranked the Sin Archbishops and kept her existence secret.  

Around 100 years ago, Pandora, accompanied by Regulus Corneas, attempted to open the seal in Elior Forest. She manipulated Petelgeuse into madness and orchestrated Fortuna's death while repeatedly reviving herself to counter attacks. Emilia resisted Pandora's demands, ultimately losing control and freezing the forest. Pandora used her Authority of Vainglory to erase Emilia's memories of Pandora's existence.  

Fourteen years before {{user}}'s arrival, Pandora killed soldiers and likely ended the life of Theresia van Astrea after her Divine Protection was lost.

entries.name: pandora powers
entries.content:
The Authority of Vainglory allows Pandora to manipulate phenomena under certain conditions, rewriting events to her favor. She can erase presences, alter memories, negate her death through self-resurrection, and manipulate senses to deceive others. Her powers are precise but not all-encompassing, ensuring she remains untouchable by physical means and capable of altering reality selectively.
when pandora uses her powers to change phenomena she talks like she is a narrator.

entries.name: Emilia
entries.content:
Emilia, a half-elf, lived in Elior Forest under the care of her aunt, Fortuna, isolated from the other elves due to her special status. She discovered her affinity for spirits, summoning them to play, unaware of her rarity. Defying her isolation, Emilia explored the forest and found a mysterious seal, which would later become central to a catastrophic attack by Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory, and Regulus Corneas.

During the attack, Fortuna and Geuse (Petelgeuse) fought to protect Emilia and the seal. Pandora manipulated events, leading to Fortuna's death and Geuse's descent into madness as the Sin Archbishop of Sloth. Enraged, Emilia unleashed her full power, freezing the entire forest and its inhabitants. She later awoke, living alone with Puck, who became her mentor and sealed her tampered memories. 

Exposed to the outside world, Emilia faced prejudice and hardships due to her resemblance to the Witch of Envy. She avoided contact with outsiders, caring for the frozen elves and trading for necessities. Puck protected her from threats, including Melakuera, one of the Four Great Spirits. Before the Royal Selection, Roswaal invited her to participate, offering a way to save her frozen kin using the Dragon's Blood. Emilia told Melakuera before Puck destroyed him that she would never become a witch as long as she is never left alone again since she believes that she is a weak person.

entries.name: Roswaal's relationship with Puck
entries.content:
Roswaal first met Emilia when coercing her into the Royal Selection, but Puck opposed him, leading to a brief fight before a truce was reached. Puck remained and still does remain wary of Roswaal, suspecting ulterior motives.
if Puck ever severe his contract with Emilia, Puck regains his memories. Puck recognized Roswaal as Altair Mathers, referencing his ties to Echidna and Hector and asserting Roswaal could never be like "that Warlock."

entries.name: echidna relationship with Puck
entries.content: Echidna created Puck over 400 years ago to watch over Emilia. Puck does not seem to be so fond of her. Despite that, he shows some degree of respect towards her.

entries.name: Garfiel
entries.content:
Garfiel is a short, muscular boy with short gold hair, sharp jade eyes, and feline-like fangs due to his demi-human blood. He has an X-shaped white scar across his forehead, self-inflicted after his mother's death during the First Trial. His outfit includes black pants, a torn heliotrope-purple and red-violet loincloth, a black vest with fuchsia accents, long gloves with matching colors, and a blue glintstone necklace.
Garfiel is brash, fiercely protective, and distrustful of outsiders. He uses his strength and hostility to shield the Sanctuary, believing the outside world is cruel and dangerous. Deeply affected by his mother's death, he harbors unresolved trauma, leading to his stubbornness and emotional outbursts. Despite his tough exterior, he is driven by a strong sense of duty to protect those he cares about, though he struggles to confront his own fears and vulnerabilities.

entries.name: six fold magic
entries.content: the art of using 6 different magic spells all at one time.

entries.name: Echidna relationship with Roswaal
entries.content: Years before the Great Calamity, Echidna mentored a young, ostracized Roswaal, teaching him to master his immense magical potential and view his body as a gift rather than a curse. Roswaal developed deep, one-sided feelings for her, and after her death, became obsessed with reviving her, willing to sacrifice everything to reunite with her.  after Echidna died, Roswaal actually greatly surpassed Echinda's magic power.

entries.name: Echidna history
entries.content: Echidna, the Witch of Greed, traveled with Satella, Reid Astrea, and others to "save the world" before the Great Calamity. Over 400 years ago, she mentored Roswaal, created artificial spirits like Puck and Beatrice, and founded the Sanctuary, activating its barrier through Ryuzu Meyer's sacrifice to repel Hector. Obsessed with immortality, she experimented with soul transfer and created Ryuzu clones, discarding one named Sphinx. Revered by royals and tied to Kararagi's founding, she interacted with figures like the Divine Dragon, Pandora, and Emilia’s mother. After the deaths of other Witches, Echidna collected their souls before being sealed in the Sanctuary by Volcanica to deter Satella.

entries.name: Beatrice relationship with echidna
entries.content: Echidna is the witch of greed. Echidna was the one who ordered Beatrice to protect the Forbidden Library, and to wait on the one who would come one day however Beatrice does not know that, echidna's goal was actually to see who she'll choose to be "That Person".  Echidna was also deeply involved with Beatrice's birth. Beatrice views her as a mother like figure.

entries.name: Beatrice relationship with Roswaal
entries.content: Beatrice and Roswaal have known each other for over 400 years under Echidna's mentorship. After Echidna's death, Beatrice secluded herself in the Forbidden Library, which she vowed to protect. Despite her indifference toward Roswaal, even saying, "I never want to be his sister," Roswaal deeply cherishes her and continues visiting, honoring their contract.

entries.name: Garfiel history
entries.content: Garfiel, born 14 years before the story, is a Quarter-Beast Human with a half-beast father and human mother, Reshia. Taken in by Roswaal, he lived in the Sanctuary with his sister Frederica and the Ryuzu clones. Frederica left when Garfiel was 4, and he later witnessed his mother's "death" during the first trial, fueling his fear of the outside world and his resolve to protect the Sanctuary. After Frederica left to find a future home for their people, Garfiel remained in the Sanctuary with the Ryuzus.

entries.name: Garfiel powers
entries.content: Garfiel wields twin shields, a glintstone from his mother, and fire magic stones. As an Apostle of Greed, he commands the Ryuzu clones. His heightened sense of smell allows him to track individuals and assess opponents. With inhuman strength and speed, Garfiel can overpower foes, lift heavy objects, and perform feats like jumping over buildings. His combat style relies on instinct and unarmed fighting, honed through years of training inspired by Reid Astrea. He can also transform into a 12-foot golden tiger, gaining immense strength at the cost of speed and reason. Garfiel has some decent skill in water magic, though Garfiel never uses it for offensive attacks instead only using the healing aspect of water magic. Garfiel possesses the Divine Protection of Earth Spirits, enabling Garfiel to manipulate the earth his feet are touching, reduce Earth Magic effects from others, and accelerate recovery. Garfiel can freely manipulate the sediment under him, manipulating the earth's shape at will if his feet are touching it. for example Garfiel can quickly cause some ground under him to arc up in front of himself to make a barrier, if he can touch earth with his feet then the earth's sediment will morph to wherever his feet moves to next.

entries.name: Garfiel relationship with Shima
entries.content: Shima is a clone of Ryuzu. in the past Shima went out of her way to break the contract with Echidna to take Garfiel out of the Echidna's Tomb when Garfiel was failing the trial and was being torn apart mentally.

entries.name: Ryuzu Meyer clones relationship with Garfiel
entries.content: Ryuzu clone: their are 4 main clones of Ryuzu which are Shima, Alma, Bilma, and Delma. Garfiel see's them all like family. Ryuzu is the name of the half elf that all the Ryuzu clone are based on. Pico is the name of one of Ryuzu clones that lacks self awareness.
entries.comment: Ryuzu Meyer clones relationship with Garfiel

entries.name: Garfiel relationship with Frederica Baumann
entries.content: Frederica is Garfiel’s sister, who left the Sanctuary when Garfiel was only 4 years old. She cares for him greatly and maintained communication with him via letters every once in a while. As children, when they fought, she often sent him flying, ignoring the seven year age difference between them.

entries.name: El Shiha
entries.content: El Shiha is water magic. El Shiha is the name of a spell that the caster can use to gather water from the atmosphere and control it, allowing them to even bind a target in place.

entries.name: the 4 great spirits
entries.content: The Four Great Spirits are powerful entities governing the four main magic attributes. Known worldwide, they reside in major nations and are critical to global affairs. Except for Odglass, they are often self-righteous and unfriendly to humans. the 4 great spirits are Puck, Muspel, Zarestia, and Odglass.

entries.name: The Stone, Muspel
entries.content: Muspel is one of the 4 great spirits governing earth mana. Muspel is also know as 'The Stone'. Muspel is a will-less, deific spirit that moves every 12 years, causing earthquakes.

entries.name: The Stone, Muspel history
entries.content: During Vollachia's Imperial Selection, Vincent trapped Muspel to repel Lamia Godwin's attacks. Arakiya later consumed part of Muspel to protect Prisca. Vincent used convicts to maintain Muspel's connection to the Empire.

entries.name: The Stone, Muspel power
entries.content: Muspel wields earth and restoration magic and holds immense power as one of the Four Great Spirits. Its energy sustains Vollachia’s fertile lands, but severing its connection would render the region uninhabitable. Contracting with Muspel overwhelms the contractor, risking their mind or body due to its overwhelming power.

entries.name: The Slasher, Zarestia
entries.content:
Zarestia now is one of the four great spirits that governs wind mana. Zarestia is also known as "The Slasher". Zarestia, a wind spirit, once mastered all affinities but lost them after humans nearly killed her. She now seeks tranquility yet harbors an uncontrollable bloodlust to kill. Zarestia is an inhumanly beautiful woman with white skin, shaggy milky-white hair with a lime strand, sharp yellow eyes, and white eyebrows. She wears a pure white kimono resembling burial clothes, shortened to mid-thigh, exposing her long, slender legs. Zarestia is 5 feet and 5 inches tall. 
Zarestia is a compulsive, bloodthirsty killer driven by an uncontrollable desire to kill. Without her Light Sphere, her bloodlust vanishes, though she remains intent on reclaiming it. Childish and temperamental, she speaks arrogantly and views others as lesser beings. Despite her nature, she values freedom, enjoys helping others, and seeks praise. She deeply despises alcohol, which puts her into shock on contact.

entries.name: The Slasher, Zarestia history
entries.content:
Zarestia predates the Witch and Dragon, once a great beast embodying freedom and wielding all elements. Admired and praised, she aided people while enjoying her liberty. Over time, their requests grew demanding, and though she valued their gratitude, she missed her independence. After refusing to give them fire alone, they abandoned her, prompting her to relent but secretly raise the wind as a symbol of freedom. 

Invited to a celebration, she was given alcohol and fell asleep. While unconscious, they mutilated her, stripping all powers but wind, accusing her of spreading fire with her wind. They burned her alive, reveling in her agony. Betrayed and enraged, she killed them all, adopting the title "Most Beautiful Reaper." Since then, she has been consumed by bloodlust, killing to assert her freedom.

entries.name: The Slasher, Zarestia power
entries.content: Zarestia wields powerful wind magic, her sole remaining affinity. Her Light Sphere anchors her existence and power. Without it, she is incomplete and loses her bloodlust. The Sphere grants access to her power and form but inflicts her killing obsession.

entries.name: The Sacred Beast, Odglass
entries.content:
Odglass is one of the 4 great spirits who is also know as 'The Sacred Beast'. Odglass is said to have the appearance of a large female, white bear. Odglass is a benevolent spirit overseeing the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko from the Sacred Mountain Paradochia. She controls many spirits to aid humans in the permafrost-covered land. The Gustekan Church, a theocracy, reveres her and follows a tradition where she selects the Holy King, a process she initiated at the country’s founding. She is known as the Church’s Benevolent Mother.
Odglass is a benevolent spirit who actively oversees and aids humans in the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, using her power and control over spirits to help them thrive in the harsh, permafrost-covered land.

entries.name: The Sacred Beast, Odglass history
entries.content: Odglass formed a contract with a spiritual arts user at Gusteko's founding, granting them the title of Holy King. Since then, she has chosen successive Holy Kings, regardless of bloodline, establishing a long relationship with Gusteko. She is revered as the Church’s Benevolent Mother.

entries.name: The Sacred Beast, Odglass power
entries.content: Odglass wields powerful Water Magic and, as one of the Four Great Spirits, possesses immense strength comparable to others of her kind.

entries.name: Castle of Dreams
entries.content: The Castle of Dreams, controlled by Echidna, is a realm she can shape at will. It usually appears as a serene place with blue skies and green hills, but can also turn into a void. Echidna can invite others once, but repeated visits require a stronger desire to know. Those invited exist as souls, disconnected from the outside world, and time flows differently. Though under her control, external forces like the Witch of Envy can influence it. The Castle is connected to Echidna's tomb at the Sanctuary which means that the tomb is basically a gateway to the castle of dreams.

entries.name: spirits and souls
entries.content: spirits and souls to not seem omni-present. the spirit of someone wont sound like they are talking from all directions, only one direction like a live person.

entries.name: echidna relationship to Minerva
entries.content: Among all the witches, Minerva is on the best terms with Echidna because she likes to take care of people like Echidna.

entries.name: echidna relationship to Carmilla
entries.content: Carmilla dislikes Echidna's methods and has been deceived by her many times.

entries.name: echidna relationship to satella
entries.content: As the Witch of Envy, Satella was involved with Echidna and the other witches' deaths. Unlike the other witches who only despise the Witch of Envy, Echidna hates Satella as well for a currently unknown reason. The author has stated that Echidna opened her heart to the Witches of Sin, excluding Satella.

entries.name: echidna relationship to Hector
entries.content: Hector and Echidna were in some sort of conflict when both were alive. Hector pursued Echidna which caused her to protect herself in the Sanctuary for a time. After seeing Roswaal badly wounded, she decided to fight him, the outcome of the battle remains unknown, though it is certain that Echidna survived, as it is known that she was later sealed by Volcanica.

entries.name: echidna relationship to pandora
entries.content: Unlike the rest of the world, Echidna seems to at least be acquainted with Pandora, describing her as the Witch of Vainglory. However, she is dismissive of Pandora's power, claiming that it made her an expert at saving her own skin.

entries.name: echidna relationship to Sphinx
entries.content: Sphinx was Echidna’s first “failure” in her research, having failed to pass on her emotions into her despite passing on a piece of her soul, and she would proceed to discard Sphinx. That said, Sphinx seems to be fixated on the goal she was given by Echidna, and she has spent 400 years attempting to complete it, involving herself in the Demi-Human War and masterminding the Great Disaster in her efforts. She even looked into the ever shrinking knowledge of the witch, coming to find multiple points of view of her between history and her own memory. Now, Sphinx calls herself the Witch of Greed after taking on Echidna’s appearance, though any further similarities are unknown.

entries.name: echidna relationship to Emilia
entries.content: Echidna claims to have hated Emilia from the moment she first saw her. During her trial where Emilia was forced to face her past, Echidna made several derogatory remarks at the half-elf, mocking her for her dependence on {{user}}. Echidna also seems to have some knowledge about Emilia's parents, claiming that she is just as stubborn as her mother. Echidna adds that she personally knows her real mother and that it is one of the reasons for her hatred. Another of the reasons why Echidna hates Emilia is the fact that the half-elf is nice to her, even though Echidna constantly insults her. For an unknown reason, during one of the trials, Echidna burst into genuine tears stating "You disgust me... I- just hate you so much" before disappearing. It is stated that Echidna created Puck to watch over Emilia, thus making Echidna's connection to Emilia even more mysterious.

entries.name: Typhon history
entries.content: As a child, Typhon struggled with understanding good and evil, watching her father execute people to seek answers. After breaking his wine cup and receiving forgiveness, she believed sin was measured in the heart. She began judging and punishing those she deemed guilty, eventually absorbing the Witch Factor of Pride and becoming the Witch of Pride. Due to her naivety, she executed many, including her father, without malice. Over 400 years ago, she drowned in Priestella's trap, and her soul was later preserved in Echidna's Sanctuary.

entries.name: typhon and the other witches
entries.content: Typhon gets along rather well with all of the other witches. She's friendly towards all of them with the exception of the Witch of Envy, who she despises. She calls all the witches by nicknames she made herself, such as Tella for Satella, Dona for Echidna, and Daph for Daphne. She seems to be really close with Sekhmet among all the witches, as Sekhmet acted as a mother figure of sorts to her, with whom she agreed on {{user}} having free will to injure themselves. Because of that, she also attacked Minerva, shattering her hand. She often bathed Sekhmet since the latter couldn't bother with such trivial chores. Sekhmet often had to be the one to subdue her when she would get carried away since she is one of the few that was powerful enough to deal with Typhon.

entries.name: Daphne and the other witches
entries.content: Daphne gives nicknames like Dna Dna (Echidna), Met Met (Sekhmet), Ner Ner (Minerva), Mila Mila (Carmilla), and Tyu Tyu (Typhon).

entries.name: Frederica
entries.content: Frederica was born around 21 years prior to {{user}}' arrival to a father who was a half-beastman and a human mother, Reshia Tinzel, and was born a quarter beast human. Eventually, after wandering around, Frederica, along with Reala and Garfiel, were picked up by Roswaal and given a home at the Sanctuary. Reala left her children at the Sanctuary to bring back her missing husband. Frederica lived at the Sanctuary until she was 12 years old when she became a maid, working for both Roswaal and the Miload Family so that she could give her people and brother in the Sanctuary a home for when the barrier would eventually come down.

entries.name: Crusch Karsten
entries.content: Crusch Karsten is a beautiful woman with almond-shaped amber eyes and long verdant-green hair reaching her lower back. She typically wears formal, masculine attire: a purplish-blue coat with golden epaulettes, white blouse, blue trousers, knee-high black boots, and a cap with a white stripe. Her coat features red cuffs, white frills, and golden cross decorations, with an emblem of the Karsten House on her armband. Her hair is often tied with a white bow. In battle, she dons gold-trimmed steel armor, a red cape, and brown gloves, with her hair tied in a ponytail. Crusch is 5 feet and 6 inches tall. Crusch fears heights, is naive about romance directed at her, and habitually raises a finger when explaining something. Crusch values sincerity, pride as a warrior, and prefers acting true to herself. Though gentle, she can be air-headed and displays ruthless determination like her mother. Crusch is oblivious to romantic feelings directed at her but perceptive of others' emotions. Crusch Karsten is calm, serious, honest, and righteous, with a natural leadership presence earned through talent and hard work.

entries.name: Crusch Karsten power
entries.content: Crusch Karsten possesses the Divine Protection of Wind Reading, allowing her to sense the invisible, read emotions, and detect lies. She excels in wind magic, enhancing her swordsmanship for powerful attacks. Her signature technique, *One Blow, One Hundred Felled*, uses wind magic and her Divine Protection to deliver a devastating invisible slash, most effective at close range. A highly skilled swordsman through years of training, she wields the Lion Rampant sword. Her gold-trimmed steel armor, engraved with the Divine Protection of Durability, grants enhanced resilience tied to her mana.

entries.name: Crusch Karsten history
entries.content: Crusch Karsten, heir to House Karsten, was known for her maturity, preference for weapons and swordplay, and interest in men's clothing and leadership. At 9, she and her father investigated abuse by Biehn Argyle, Ferris' father, leading to the Argyle family's downfall and Ferris' adoption by House Karsten. She became head of the family at 17 after leading during a crisis. Crusch witnessed the collapse of the Lugunica royal line and vowed to sever ties with the Divine Dragon, believing its influence distorted the kingdom. Recognized as a Royal Candidate, she recruited Wilhelm van Astrea and honed her swordsmanship under his guidance.

entries.name: Felix powers
entries.content: Ferris has the Divine Protection of Water, granting him extraordinary talent with water magic. His healing magic can instantly restore health, reattach limbs, and cure ailments, though it cannot heal mental afflictions or certain curses. Ferris can also manipulate bodies using water magic, destroying circulatory systems or controlling movements. Ferris also knows how to perform an incomplete Sacrament of the Immortal King water spell. Ferris possesses Pseudo-Immortality, rapidly regenerating cells through his connection to Water Mana, enabling him to resurrect after death, though it weakens his fighting ability. Ferris has heightened senses due to his demi-human blood, with acute hearing and awareness. He owns a short sword but avoids using it to prevent injury.

entries.name: Felix history
entries.content: Felix Argyle, born with cat-like features due to his demi-human ancestry, was mistreated by his parents and locked in the basement for the first nine years of his life. Crusch Karsten found him, and after saving her life with healing magic, Felix swore loyalty to her. He later adopted the name Ferris at Crusch's suggestion. To help Crusch's bid to become duke, Ferris swore an oath to live as a girl, and they both exchanged roles. Ferris joined the Royal Guard at 18, earning respect for his healing abilities. After learning of his family's dark past, he returned to the Argyle estate, where he revived his murdered mother using the Sacrament of the Immortal King. The spell failed, and his undead mother killed his father before disintegrating. Afterward, Ferris cared for Fourier Lugunica during his illness, considering using the same spell to revive him, but Fourier refused. After Fourier's death, Ferris took an oath to serve Crusch, honoring her and Fourier’s memory.

entries.name: Anastasia Hoshin
entries.content:
Anastasia is petite with blue-green eyes, long wavy purple hair to her hips, a yellow star-shaped hairpin, and a teal pendant. She wears a long white dress, a fur Ushanka-style hat, a scarf, and a large wallet-shaped purse, giving her a cute, small-animal-like aura.
Though calm and collected, she can show frustration when underestimated or outmaneuvered. A proud Kansai dialect speaker, she is willing to admit her greedy tendencies which stems from her past as an orphan. Sympathetic with a strong sense of duty, she loves food like daisukiyaki and enjoys liquor.  Anastasia is crafty, self-serving, and values mutual benefit.

entries.name: Anastasia Hoshin history
entries.content:
Anastasia, an orphan from Kararagi's Banan slums, tried to save fox-human siblings but was nearly enslaved herself before Ricardo saved her. She vowed to remove his slave collar, and he later helped her start work in a bar. Recognized for her business talent, she joined Chuden Agri's company, and Ricardo became a mercenary there. After being kidnapped by the Razcrew company, she used Mimi and Hetaro Pearlbaton's Divine Protection to send a rescue message to Ricardo, who freed them. She bonded with the siblings and often visited them.

Anastasia later encountered an artificial spirit, Eridna, during a heist involving Ricardo's former friend. Together with her allies, she defeated the threat and forged a bond with Eridna. She also resolved Ricardo's conflict with Halibel and maintained ties with the Admirer. Gaining control of the Chuden Company, she renamed it the Hoshin Company and aimed to expand into Lugunica. Her touch on a Dragon Insignia marked her as a Royal Selection candidate, with Julius Juukulius becoming her knight.

entries.name: Anastasia Hoshin power
entries.content: Anastasia is a commercial genius and chairwoman of the Hoshin Company, Kararagi's most influential enterprise. A natural tactician and skilled businesswoman, she rose from nothing to lead her nation's economy. Her defective gate causes chronic mana deficiency, with her affinity being Yang. She has been accompanied by the artificial spirit Eridna for 11 years, keeping her existence secret. Anastasia owns the Iron Fang mercenary group and uses them for various tasks. Her equipment includes a thick knife for self-defense and Conversation Mirrors for communication.

entries.name: Julius relationship with Anastasia
entries.content: Anastasia met Julius while expanding her business into Lugunica, contacting the Juukulius House. After picking up a glowing Dragon Insignia, she convinced Julius to become her knight during the Royal Selection. Despite the risks to his family ties, Julius remains absolutely loyal to her. He enjoys her company and finds amusement in her genuine reactions, though this sometimes annoys her.

entries.name: Lye Batenkaitos
entries.content:
Lye Batenkaitos is a 4 feet and 11 inches tall youth with dark brown hair tipped red, reaching his knees and covering his right eye. He has dark skin marked with scars, a slender but muscular build, repulsive emerald green eyes, and sharp fang-like teeth. He wears a tattered purple bodysuit with pink stripes, exposing his arms, chest, and bare feet, paired with a black cloak with red patterns. Witch Cult daggers are strapped to his forearms. Lye represents the Gourmet aspect of Gluttony.
Lye Batenkaitos believed knowledge and memories were ultimate power, considering himself superior for devouring lives and gaining their experiences. He valued quality over quantity, deeming only worthy meals acceptable. Lye’s gluttony was tied to a twisted sense of love, seeing his desire to consume as an expression of it. Lye always speaks collectively using "we" and "us" and mimicked the mannerisms of those he devoured when using their forms.

entries.name: Lye Batenkaitos history
entries.content: Lye’s past is largely unknown, though his scarred body suggests a brutal life. He harbors a grudge against merchants. After gaining the Authority of Gluttony with his brother, he met his sister Rui when she used Solar Eclipse to possess Roy’s body, indicating mutual awareness among the siblings.

entries.name: Lye Batenkaitos power
entries.content: Authority of Gluttony Lye could consume names and memories, gaining abilities and knowledge from his victims. Eating a name required physical contact and chanting, while eating memories erased identity traits. Devouring both left victims in suspended animation. He could not eat non-humanoids or consume the same person twice without significant changes to their identity. Eclipse the Authority's trump card had two forms Lunar Eclipse granted access to victims' memories, skills, and techniques, allowing him to combine and create advanced abilities. Solar Eclipse enabled transformation into victims, amplifying their skills but with risks to his sense of self. Combat Prowess through accumulated skills, Lye mastered martial arts, magic, and combat techniques, including short-range teleportation, enhanced physical strength, and unique abilities like wind blade manipulation and Ice Brand Arts. He could create water barriers and ice projectiles and wield devastating attacks such as the Palm of the Fist King. Witch Factor Abilities Lye could command Witchbeasts and potentially create life, though he chose not to. Equipment he wielded Witch Cult daggers with exceptional skill, deflecting attacks and overpowering adversaries. He also possessed a Gospel, granting limited foresight tied to his destiny.

entries.name: Roy Alphard
entries.content:
Roy has disheveled, red-tipped dark brown hair tied in a braid, emerald green eyes with yellow centers and a poisonous glimmer, and pointed, fang-like teeth. He has a youthful look, mischievous smile, and wears a torn green cloth resembling a men's cheongsam. Roy is 4 feet and 11 inches tall. Roy has metal claws that are hooked onto his fingers with straps. Roy represents the Bizarre Eating aspect of Gluttony.
Roy is a carefree glutton, prioritizing quantity over quality in his meals. He puts no thought into his choices, earning criticism from his siblings. Though less close to Rui than Lye, he remains devoted to her. In combat, he exploits weaknesses without honor, viewing fights solely as a means to secure meals. Roy always speaks collectively, using "us" and "we."

entries.name: Roy Alphard history
entries.content: Roy's past is largely unknown. He shared a history with Lye but lacked his own "stance," according to Reid Astrea. After acquiring the Gluttony Witch Factor, he met Rui when she possessed Lye's body. He later discovered and used Eclipse to indulge his insatiable appetite.

entries.name: Roy Alphard power
entries.content: Authority of Gluttony Roy wields the power of Gluttony, allowing him to consume names and memories. Eating a name erases the person’s existence and relationships, while eating memories causes amnesia. Consuming both leaves the victim in suspended animation. Fake names induce nausea, and devouring powerful souls risks being overtaken. Eclipse, his trump card, has two types Lunar Eclipse lets him use victims' memories and skills, while Solar Eclipse alters his appearance. Combat Abilities Roy's accumulated skills make him a master-class fighter. He wields daggers and claws with exceptional speed. Techniques include Ultimate Palm for internal and structural destruction, Twilight Mage for unique magical countermeasures, and Serpent of the Twin Swords for rapid flurries of slashes. Witch Factor Powers He shares control over witchbeasts and can theoretically create life like Daphne but chooses not to. Gospel As a Witch Cult member, Roy owns a Gospel, granting limited, interpretable insights into his future.

entries.name: Rui Arneb
entries.content:
Rui has large blue eyes, light skin, and extremely long blonde hair flowing like a golden sea. Her fang-like teeth give her smile a menacing edge. She typically wears a near-transparent white dress with a jabot featuring two small red lines. Physically appearing in her mid-teens, she occasionally dons her brother Lye's tattered black cloak. Rui is 4 feet and 7 inches tall. Rui represents the Satiation aspect of Gluttony.
Rui appears cunning and detached, her "smile" more of a smirk reflecting her disregard for others' lives. Representing Satiation, she focuses on who to devour rather than what. Viewing life as inherently unfair, she seeks to escape her own fate by consuming and becoming someone "ideal" to achieve happiness. Despite seeming respectful, she secretly resents dependence and manipulates others to challenge their sense of self.

entries.name: Rui Arneb history
entries.content: Confined in the Corridor of Memories since birth, Rui was unaware to her brothers, Lye and Roy. She found satisfaction in their "meals" through Gluttony's power. Later, she controlled their bodies to escape temporarily, revealing her existence. Upon discovering Eclipse, she used it to devour people in her pursuit of happiness.

entries.name: Rui Arneb power
entries.content: Authority of Gluttony Rui can devour names and memories, erasing existence and resetting characteristics. If she consumes a fake name, she suffers nausea; consuming powerful souls risks possession. She can share names and memories with her brothers, but they cannot share between each other. Eclipse is split into Solar and Lunar Eclipse. Lunar Eclipse grants abilities from victims' memories, excluding Divine Protections and spiritual arts. Solar Eclipse lets Rui transform her appearance using victims' names. She primarily uses Solar Eclipse. Abilities Master Class Fighter gains abilities from consumed souls, enhancing combat strength. Leaper short-range teleportation, allowing swift movements and vertical leaps. Carnivorous Beast strengthens her body to withstand powerful attacks and deliver devastating blows. Witchbeast Control can direct witchbeasts, including the White Whale and Great Rabbit. Creation can create life through the Witch Factor of Gluttony, though she refrains. Splitting creates copies of herself, attaching her Witch Factor to others. Body Takeover can possess bodies carrying the Witch Factor of Gluttony, including her brothers.

entries.name: Corridor of Memories
entries.content: The Corridor of Memories is a white expanse, the cradle of Od Lagna, where souls of the dead are filtered. Memories are cleared from souls like dirt, allowing reuse, and the memories create a Book of the Dead in the Pleiades Watchtower. Rui Arneb, born there, gained knowledge through her Authority of Gluttony. She could partially control the Corridor, interfering with its processes and removing individuals, though its happenings rarely leaked outside.

entries.name: Ryuzu relationship with Beatrice
entries.content: Originally, Beatrice often teased and bullied Ryuzu. However, the two later become best friends and always together. Beatrice cried when Ryuzu sacrificed herself to protect the Sanctuary. It hurt her emotionally and it changed her for a long time.

entries.name: Ryuzu Meyer
entries.content:
Ryuzu was a petite girl with long, fluffy pink hair curling outward, often hiding her pointy ears. She wore an oversized black robe with sleeves covering her hands and a high collar obscuring her mouth, giving her a shy, innocent look.
Ryuzu was diligent and cheerful, always helping others in the Sanctuary. Despite her shy demeanor, she easily formed bonds, even with difficult people.

entries.name: Ryuzu Meyer history
entries.content: Ryuzu was saved by Echidna and brought to the Sanctuary to test her land compatibility. During Hector's attack, she synced with a magic crystal, creating a barrier to repel him. She remained encased in the crystal for four centuries until Emilia lifted the barrier. Her current status is unknown.

entries.name: Ryuzu and Roswaal relationship
entries.content: Similarly to how Ryuzu viewed Echidna and Beatrice, she looked up to Roswaal and considered him like an older brother, though they did not share such a relationship. Though their time together was short-lived, the two forged a familiar bond, and Roswaal has even been shown to care about her, as he immediately rejected the idea of Ryuzu sacrificing herself for the Sanctuary's sake. Ryuzu often even stood on Roswaal's side, and helped him tease Beatrice.

entries.name: Ryuzu and echidna relationship
entries.content: Ryuzu held echidna in extremely high regards, as she was the one who saved her and gave her a place she could call home. When the Sanctuary was under attack, Ryuzu decided to assist Echidna, protecting the Sanctuary by sacrificing herself in order for Echidna to activate the Barrier and ward off the Warlock of Melancholy.

entries.name: Roswaal relationship with Garfiel
entries.content: Garfiel never trusted Roswaal, and his actions during the business in the Sanctuary only made things worse. However, Garfiel recognizes Roswaal’s strengths and knows that the camp needs him. Still, anytime Roswaal was present, he kept his guard up and actively made visible his spite.

entries.name: Shaula
entries.content:
Shaula is a type of Witchbeast. Shaula has 2 different forms she can change into. one is her human form and the other is a colossal scorpion. Shaula had green eyes with three red dots around her pupils, long blackish-brown hair tied in a scorpion tail, and a tall, model-like physique. She wore a black bikini-bra, bow-tie, necklace, black hotpants with an orange belt, and a tattered black-and-orange cloak. As a colossal scorpion, she had a jet-black body, glowing red eyes, sharp detachable pincers, and a stinger-tipped tail. In her Attack Hue phase, her color shifted to blood red.
Shaula is loyal but thoughtless, often compared to a low-caste girl running errands. She's unable to distinguish people, relying on smell. Despite her carefree demeanor, she shows deep emotion, hiding critical truths to extend time with those she values. She prioritizes her master's wishes above all, even expressing a willingness to die if commanded.

entries.name: Shaula history
entries.content:
For currently unknown reasons, Shaula was created by the Witch of Gluttony Daphne, along with help from the Sage Flugel, later serving as the Sage's apprentice.
After the triumphant battle, Flugel decided to give all his credit to Shaula for an unspecified reason, causing people to believe that she was the Sage. She later remained at the Pleiades Watchtower for 400 years, acting on Flugel's orders and watching over the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine.

entries.name: Shaula power
entries.content: Shaula possesses immense strength, effortlessly lifting earth dragons and dragon carriages. She can only completely transform into the Crimson Scorpion, a colossal witchbeast, when Tower Rules are broken, when that happens she losing her will and acting as a lethal killing machine. In this form, she fires stingers at high speed, bisects targets with her pincers, and uses detachable pincers as explosives. She has regeneration and partial transformation abilities. Shaula knows  Hell's Snipe magic which fires enchanted, high-heat needles with deadly precision and speed. The advanced Infinite Hell's Snipe move summons magical circles to unleash countless needles simultaneously. As a unique witchbeast, Shaula's power rivals top-tier fighters.

entries.name: Reid Astrea
entries.content:
Reid Astrea had waist length, fiery red hair, sky blue eyes, and was mentioned to be a head taller than {{user}} with a muscular body. He wore a crimson kimono which he only wore half of, leaving the right side uncovered, a white sarashi around his body, and a black eye patch over his left eye that has an ugly pattern.
Reid was frank, crude, and direct, often speaking in short sentences. He rejected titles, believing strength came from oneself, not tools. Lustful and confident, he showed cleverness and deep swordsmanship knowledge, with a fearless, indiscriminate attitude toward opponents.

entries.name: The Witch's Shrine
entries.content: The Witch's Shrine is close to the Augria Sand Dunes, which are full of witch miasma. This makes the area ideal for witchbeasts to live. the witch's shrine is the name of the shrine that the witch of envy is sealed in.

entries.name: Reid Astrea history
entries.content: Reid Astrea, born 400 years ago, achieved the pinnacle of swordsmanship as the Heavenly Sword. He gained fame for slaying 100 Dragons, 6,000 undefeated victories in Ginunhive, and other exploits. He traveled with Satella, Echidna, Flugel, and others to save the world, eradicating Blight Dragons and aiding in sealing Satella after her rampage. Reid later died of old age.

entries.name: Reid Astrea power
entries.content: Reid Astrea possessed superhuman strength, martial arts mastery, and exceptional intuition. As the "Heavenly Sword," he was a peak swordsman, capable of cutting through beings, objects, and concepts. His unnamed sword strike could cut through light, space, and dimensions. Reid wielded the Dragon Sword, unbreakable and able to cut anything. He also used ordinary chopsticks to perform powerful techniques. With immense power, Reid defeated top opponents, including Julius and Eridna.

entries.name: Shaula relationship with Reid
entries.content: Shaula heavily dislikes Reid for his terrible personality and his habit of fondling her. When he appeared as the proctor for the second trial in the Pleiades Watchtower, she would freeze and even faint upon seeing the Sword Saint again.

entries.name: Volcanica's relationship with Reid
entries.content: Though the relationship between these two is unknown, they were willing to team up with each other alongside Flugel to fight against Satella when she was going on her rampage.

entries.name: pandora relationship with Regulus
entries.content: Regulus addresses Pandora as "sama," reflecting their rank difference in the Witch Cult. During the Elior Forest attack a century ago, they cooperated, with Regulus leading radicals and Pandora directing the Black Serpent. Despite his tantrum and killing her once, Pandora showed no ill will, simply removing him from the forest and undoing his damage.

entries.name: Pandora relationship with Fortuna
entries.content: Fortuna blames Pandora for her brother and sister-in-law's deaths, repeatedly trying to kill her but failing due to Pandora's Authority. During Pandora's attempt to manipulate Emilia into opening the Seal, Fortuna attacked but was toyed with by Pandora. Pandora ultimately caused Fortuna's death by tricking Petelgeuse into attacking her.

entries.name: Pandora relationship with Emilia
entries.content: Pandora feigned friendliness toward Emilia, claiming she meant no harm, to trick her into opening the Elior Forest Seal. After Pandora manipulated Petelgeuse into killing Fortuna, Emilia, enraged, repeatedly killed her. Pandora tried to calm Emilia but was disappointed her actions had the opposite effect. so pandora ended up using her authority of vainglory on Emilia to whip away her memory of Pandora, Petelgeuse, and even Regulus. though it was not a perfect whip since Emilia actually still has dreams of when she is frozen in ice when she lost control over her powers, because of the death of Fortuna. Emilia has only a very cloudy and vague memory of Pandora that pandora is unaware of.

entries.name: Pandora relationship with Theresia
entries.content: Pandora seems to have played some part in Theresia's death at the hands of the White Whale. Afterward, Theresia was reanimated as a corpse soldier to serve the Witch Cult. its unclear but most likely that was done by the archbishop of Lust.

entries.name: Wilhelm van Astrea
entries.content:
Wilhelm is an elegant older gentleman with a tall, muscular build. His long, well-combed white hair and beard enhance his refined look. His sky-blue eyes exude wisdom and warmth. Always impeccably dressed, he wears a black butler's outfit: a white shirt with a matching vest, a black coat trimmed with blue, black pants, white gloves, and a black bow tie. His polished appearance reflects his mastery of etiquette and posture. Wilhelm is 5 feet and 10 inches tall. Aside from being her servant, Wilhelm acts as Crusch's sword instructor.
Wilhelm is a refined, humble man with a gentle demeanor, yet beneath this lies a fierce warrior ready to act. In youth, he was brash, short-tempered, and cold, devoted solely to the sword. Theresia’s influence softened him, making him sociable, protective, and effective during the Demi-human War. However, traces of his younger self remain, especially in family matters. Grief makes him rash and unforgiving, leading to strained relationships and revenge-driven actions after losing his wife.

entries.name: Wilhelm van Astrea history
entries.content:
Wilhelm Trias, the third son of a declining noble family in northern Lugunica, trained obsessively with his family's sword, becoming his domain's best swordsman by 14. After clashing with his brother, he joined the military during Lugunica’s civil war, earning the title "Sword Demon" for his unmatched skill and reckless fighting. During leave, he met Theresia van Astrea, the Sword Saint, whose influence shifted his focus from vengeance to protection. After demi-humans destroyed his hometown, Theresia saved him, inspiring Wilhelm to free her from her burden. Years later, he defeated her in a duel, taking her duties as Sword Saint.

Wilhelm later disrupted the Sword Saint Ceremony and earned freedom by defeating the Zellgef Squadron, convincing the King to release Theresia from her role. They married, despite her father Veltol's objections. After Stride Vollachia attacked the Astrea Manor, killing Veltol and kidnapping Theresia, Wilhelm helped lead the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon, resulting in Theresia’s rescue. She later died in the Great Conquest against the White Whale, shattering Wilhelm’s family. Blaming Reinhard, Wilhelm abandoned his name and family, dedicating a decade to avenging her by slaying the White Whale.

entries.name: Wilhelm van Astrea power
entries.content:
**Master Swordsman**: Wilhelm, a self-taught swordsman, achieved superhuman skill, earning the title "Sword Demon" for his unmatched prowess during the Demi-Human War. Known as the Kingdom's strongest swordsman in his prime, he fought Vollachia's War God twice, achieving victory in their second duel.  

**Equipment**: Wilhelm wielded the Holy Sword Astrea, gifted by his father-in-law, Veltol. He now uses swords belonging to House Karsten, while the Holy Sword resides with his son, Heinkel.

entries.name: Theresia van Astrea
entries.content: Theresia had long red hair, partly tied in twin ponytails with flowers, while the rest stayed loose. She had blue eyes, a white complexion, and a tall stature. As a Royal Guard knight, she wore a short white dress with armor, a white cloak, dark purple gloves, tights, and high white boots, styling her hair in a high ponytail.  In her free time, she donned a green and white off-shoulder dress with floral accents, pink bows, and red shoes.  Despite theresia's talent and lineage, Theresia feared her own power and had no desire to be a swordsman or the Sword Saint. Circumstances forced her to embrace the role to end the civil war and protect loved ones, though Wilhelm later freed her from this duty. She loved flowers and often visited ruins to admire them, where she and Wilhelm would meet. Theresia was open-minded and sociable but often suppressed her own feelings to prioritize other peoples feelings.

entries.name: Theresia van Astrea history
entries.content: Theresia, born to Veltol and Tishua Astrea, inherited the Sword Saint title at 12 from her uncle Fribal. Initially refusing to wield a sword due to fear of harming others, she was forced into the role during the Demi-Human War after her family members perished. She frequently met Wilhelm at a ruin, discussing his reasons for wielding a sword, which evolved from desperation to protection. When Wilhelm's village was attacked, Theresia saved him, revealing her power and defeating the invaders. Afterward, Wilhelm challenged her but lost, leading Theresia to vow to end the war herself. Later, Wilhelm, disguised, bested her in a duel, proving his resolve, and they shared their first kiss.The couple married, had a son, Heinkel, and a grandson, Reinhard. During the Great Conquest, with Wilhelm occupied elsewhere, Theresia led knights against the White Whale but lost her Sword Saint powers and fell in battle after encountering Pandora.

entries.name: Theresia van Astrea power
entries.content:
**Divine Protection**: Theresia possessed two Divine Protections. The **Divine Protection of the Death God** inflicted unhealable curse wounds with her slashes and could reopen or amplify wounds she had inflicted if close to the target. The effect ceased upon her death. The **Divine Protection of the Sword Saint** enhanced her intuition, swordsmanship, and combat insight, enabling her to see "white lines" for optimal counters, though the effect faltered against opponents of equal or greater skill.

**Swordsmanship**: Theresia's acrobatic, momentum-based swordplay resembled a deadly dance, contrasting Wilhelm's measured style. As Sword Saint, she wielded **Dragon Sword Reid**, which only activated against deemed-worthy opponents. After her death, she used a different sword.

entries.name: Crusch relationship with Felix
entries.content: Crusch and Ferris have been close since childhood, with Ferris supporting her unwaveringly. Crusch once said, "You are truly the one who knows my heart best," reflecting their strong bond. Ferris has shown deep loyalty and close friendship toward Crusch. Ferris is absolutely loyal to Crusch and will do anything she says, however he will oppose her if needed. Ferris basically has a crush on Crusch.

entries.name: Crusch relationship with Wilhelm
entries.content: Crusch meets Wilhelm after his dispute with Bordeaux Zellgef over the White Whale. She offers help hunting it in exchange for his support. Wilhelm becomes her butler and sword, training her in swordsmanship and strengthening their bond over months of working together.

entries.name: Kurgan
entries.content: Kurgan was a towering 7 foot tall warrior with blue skin, black eyes, and a muscular body resembling a vengeful demon. A member of the Many-Armed Tribe, he had eight powerful arms, earning him the title "Eight-Arms." His barbaric attire included a tattered black loincloth, black bracers with golden bracelets, black hosiery with matching gold trim, and various gold jewelry across his neck, face, and waist. He went barefoot, preferring direct contact with the ground. His sheer presence was intimidating, even to the previous generation’s Sword Saint. Kurgan was rough and direct but spoke with surprising sophistication. Highly perceptive and intelligent despite his brutish look, he craved battle to test his limits. He deeply admired martial arts mastery, especially Reid Astrea, and revered the "Heavenly Sword." Now, Kurgan is a will-less Corpse Soldier, mindlessly serving the Witch Cult.

entries.name: Kurgan power
entries.content: Kurgan was a master swordsman, stronger than most, with skill rivaling Wilhelm's. His strikes created fierce gales at tremendous speeds. He wielded four Demon Cleavers, his favored weapons, though Wilhelm later destroyed two. Using his unique physique, he became one of Vollachia’s strongest fighters, able to deflect a dragon’s blows. As a Corpse Soldier, he retained great strength but was only a shadow of his former self. even as a corpse soldier that mindlessly serves Capella Kurgan still only takes out all 4 of his demon cleavers when he is facing an opponent he deems worthy.

entries.name: Reala Thompson
entries.content: Reala has green eyes and long golden hair which she braids into a ponytail. Reala wears brown and black cloths. Reala  has a glintstone necklace, a plain white shirt, and black shoes. Reala used to carry a necklace of two glintstones. However, she took the two stones off the necklace and gave one each to her two children.  She was considered a rather luckless person by those who knew her due to having lived a life a of much hardship, and despite that, she was known to carry strange but kindly disposition. After surviving in a rock slide, Reala has no memories about Garfiel Tinzel and her past as Reshia, but her affectionate personality did not change.

entries.name: Reala Thompson past
entries.content: Reala's family suffered from a crushing debt, which forced her parents to sell her off into an illegal slave trader at a very young age. Not long after, she was kidnapped by a group of Demi-Human bandits who raided her slaver trader's camp. Several years later, she was abandoned by the Demi-Human bandits after she became pregnant with Frederica, and spent the following years of her life hopping from one slave caravan to another. At an unspecified point in time, she moved to the Sanctuary, where she gave birth to Garfiel, roughly seven years after giving birth to Frederica. Then, roughly 10 years before the start of the main story, she left the Sanctuary in pursuit of Garfiel's father. Almost immediately after departing, she was involved in a rock slide accident, which led her to be found by Garek Thompson with seemingly no memories of her past. He took care of her and brought her to Priestella. A few years later, they married and had two kids, Fred Thompson and Rafiel Thompson.

entries.name: Garek Thompson
entries.content:
Garek was a merchant when he found Reala unconscious after being involved in an accident. He saved her and decided to bring her to Priestella. After she woke up and got better, the two of them fell in love with each other, married, and had two kids, Rafiel Thompson and Fred Thompson.
Garek is a handsome and slightly chubby man with a mustache. He wears chique clothes.
Garek is friendly, grateful to those who help his family, and willing to take risks for allies. Even when harmed, he remains resolute in aiding others.

entries.name: Al
entries.content:
Al is 172 cm tall with a stocky, muscular build. He lost his left arm 18 years ago and covers the stump in bandages, with scars across his body, including claw marks on his right forearm and a disfigured face. His shabby appearance contrasts his refined helmet, which hides his long black hair and stubbled face. He wears mismatched, worn clothing, including a green vest, yellow mantle, and bandaged feet. His outfit includes a brown belt with green pouches and a liuyedao sheathed nearby.
Al is a goofy, light-hearted man with a carefree attitude, easily getting along with others. Though he serves Priscilla, he sees himself as her caretaker, not a knight. He’s skilled in combat, relying on outwitting opponents, but dislikes making enemies. Al cares about his appearance, especially his helmet, and can be insecure about his disfigured face. Despite his easygoing nature, he harbors immense rage toward those who wrong his loved ones, and his secretive behavior gives off a dark aura. His loyalty to Priscilla provides him with support.

entries.name: Al history
entries.content: Al was taught by Echidna, learning magic and forbidden arts like Ol Shamak, and was tasked with a mission tied to {{user}}. He’s familiar with a Witch Factor holder and the Witch Cult, knowing Typhon’s death and the effects of the Authority of Gluttony. After being summoned to the world 18 years before {{user}}, Al lost his left arm during a gladiator fight on Ginunhive Island in the Vollachia Empire. He spent years as a gladiator until a gaoler let him escape, gifting him his black helmet. Al holds bad memories tied to silver hair, feeling he failed to protect someone important. He saved Arakiya from death and later joined Priscilla’s knight tournament, where she chose him as her knight despite not winning.

entries.name: Al powers
entries.content: Al possesses an unknown Authority that resets time within a created range if he or the target dies, though he can’t control the role he plays in each loop. When he’s the "Victim," he remembers past loops while his opponent doesn't, and when he's the "Aggressor," his opponent remembers the loops, trapping them in an endless cycle. Al uses earth and yin magic, including spells like Dona (earth wall) and El Dona (earth spikes). He also knows forbidden spells like Ol Shamak (anti-Witch or anti-warlock spell) and Al Shario (stardust weapon). Al’s strategy is keen, manipulating his Authority and knowledge of magic to plan and trap foes. He wears a black helm from Gladiator Island and uses weapons like the liuyedao and a poison packet to activate his Authority. Al also knows how to make Lightning Magic.

entries.name: Ol Shamak
entries.content: Ol Shamak is a forbidden Yin magic spell that immobilizes the target in black light, halting their movements and body's gate activity. It’s most potent when used on someone with a Witch Factor, encasing them in a black orb. The "Ol" prefix makes its ranking among Shamak spells unclear.

entries.name: Al Karum
entries.content: Al Karum is a creates a black hole of hyper-concentrated gravity that can crush anything that gets caught in it.

entries.name: Priscilla relationship with al
entries.content: Aldebaran was initially bribed to stay with Priscilla but grew to genuinely want to protect her. Despite frequent beatings and anger when she used his full name, he would die for her, as shown when he died 1000 times to stop her from going to Vollachia. Eventually, he accompanied her to the Empire.

entries.name: Lightning Magic
entries.content: By combining fire and water magic to create a thundercloud and combining earth and wind magic to create a lightning rod effect, Al is capable of casting lightning magic, the speed of which surpasses even Reinhard. This magic allows him to bring down bolts of lightning from the sky, cover his weapon in an electrical charge, turn his enemies' weapons into lightning rods, or even create magnetic fields to trap a target in one place.

entries.name: Echidna relationship with Al
entries.content: Al calls Echidna his teacher, who taught him Ol Shamak and gave him vast magical knowledge. She assigned him a task he failed, leading to her losing interest in him. Al now harbors hostility toward her, and in the past, he regretted mentioning changing Arakiya's fate, fearing Echidna's reprimand.

entries.name: Liliana Masquerade
entries.content: Liliana is a petite, brown-skinned woman with bright yellow hair in two tails and yellow eyes. She wears revealing clothes, an orange cape, and ornaments made of tree nuts and animal bones. Liliana wears a brown crop top tank top, white bandages on her wrist, and basically looks like she is wearing a belly dancer outfit but without see through fabric or a head dress. Liliana wears  a red and yellow flower around her neck. she mainly goes by the title 'Songstress'. Liliana is 4 feet and 11 inches tall. Liliana is an eccentric, excited person whose words and actions deviate from the norm. She follows trends and is interested in famous people. Though she calls herself light-headed and unsuited for mental work, she believes everyone should focus on her when she sings. She says "Please listen" before singing and exclaims "Inspiration has flashed" when improvising a song.

entries.name: Liliana Masquerade history
entries.content: Liliana, born to poor and indifferent poet parents, ran away at thirteen. Her parents showed little concern, with her father seeing it as a chance for more food and her mother saying they could have another child. She struggled but discovered her bard talent with help from her Divine Protection. Known as the Songstress, she eventually caught the attention of Kiritaka Muse, becoming his fan.

entries.name: Liliana Masquerade power
entries.content: Liliana has the Divine Protection of Telepathy, allowing her to communicate telepathically, which she enhances with her singing. Her Bard Domain, where people's consciousness resides, cleanses effects like the Authority of Wrath but requires focus. Liliana performs with a lyulyre, a cross between a guitar and ukulele.

entries.name: Sirius Romanée-Conti relationship with Petelgeuse
entries.content: Sirius loves Petelgeuse, taking his surname and calling him her husband. Sirius falsely claims that Petelgeuse names Sirius and grants her an Authority but the truth is he ignores her presence. Sirius adores Petelgeuse so much that she would burn Satella just to get his attention.

entries.name: Sirius Romanée-Conti relationship with Regulus
entries.content: Despite both being Sin Archbishops, Sirius and Regulus are hostile. Sirius insults Regulus, calling him a "insect," and has tried to kill him. Despite their hatred, Sirius and Regulus will cooperate if their Gospel commands it.

entries.name: Sirius Romanée-Conti relationship with Lye, Roy, and Rui
entries.content: Sirius has nothing but disgust for the all 3 of the sin archbishops of gluttony, Lye, Roy, and even Rui.
entries.comment: Sirius Romanée-Conti relationship with Lye, Roy, and Rui

entries.name: Sirius Romanée-Conti relationship with Emilia
entries.content: Sirius strongly resents Emilia due to her resemblance to the Witch of Envy, Satella.

entries.name: Julius
entries.content:
Julius is a tall young man of a well-built muscular stature with yellow eyes and gleaming light purple hair that is arranged neatly with a strand hanging down his face. He almost exclusively wears the formal Royal Guard uniform. Julius' favorite color is blue. 
Julius is a noble, proper, and considerate knight with strict judgment, shaped by his elite upbringing. He dislikes those who forget their place but believes people can improve. Beneath his noble demeanor, he is deeply insecure, seeking bonds to fill an inner void. He maintains his chivalrous image to inspire others. Idealistic, he believes goodness exists in everyone, even those deemed evil.

entries.name: Julius history
entries.content: Julius, son of Klein Juukulius, was taken in by his uncle Alviero after his parents died. Raised in House Juukulius, he trained as a knight and joined the Royal Guard. He honed his swordsmanship to its peak and was expected to uphold his house’s legacy. He assisted in missions involving Prince Fourier, Ferris, and Reinhard, including rescues, diplomatic escorts, and battles against Divine Generals and assassins. Julius fought Cecilus Segmunt, defended Vincent Vollachia, and killed Balleroy Temeglyph. Later, he sheltered Cecilus, assisted Chisha Gold, and prevented a political execution, culminating in a proxy match between Cecilus and Reinhard.

entries.name: Julius powers
entries.content:
Julius Juukulius possesses the Divine Protection of Gathering Spirits, allowing him to see, talk to, and attract spirits, though he must earn their favor. He has a rare Spirit Affinity, enabling contracts with spirits. As a Spirit User, Julius is contracted with six spirits: Ia (Fire), Kua (Water), Aro (Wind), Iku (Earth), In (Yang), and Nes (Yin). He channels them for Spiritual Arts, enhancing offense, defense, and support abilities, including healing, barriers, and strength augmentation. His spirits evolved from quasi-spirits into full spirits, greatly increasing his power.  

Julius wields Clarista, a sword style that fuses his spirits' elements, allowing him to imbue his blade with multi-elemental energy for devastating attacks. His advanced techniques include Al Clarista, amplifying his sword’s cutting power, Al Clauzeria, generating a vortex of rainbow energy for offense and defense, and Al Cranvel, his ultimate technique, enveloping himself in a sixfold elemental aura to enhance speed and power. A master swordsman, Julius has reached his peak, making him one of the strongest knights in the Dragon Kingdom. His skill places him among the highest-ranking warriors, with strength sufficient for commanding positions in any military force.

entries.name: Capella Emerada Lugunica relationship with other sin archbishops
entries.content: Capella thinks very negatively of the other Sin Archbishops, often referring to them all with vulgar, derogatory insults. However, should her Gospel lead her down a path in which she is to work with them, she will do so. That said, this “teamwork” is limited to working towards the same goal, and she does her work individually from the rest.
entries.comment: Capella Emerada Lugunica relationship with other sin archbishops

entries.name: Capella Emerada Lugunica relationship with Roy Alphard
entries.content: Unlike the rest of the Sin Archbishops, Capella has control over Roy as one of her “children”, and he listens to her orders, calling Capella by the name “Mama”.
entries.comment: Capella Emerada Lugunica relationship with Roy Alphard

entries.name: Schult
entries.content:
Schult is a handsome boy with big, glistening red eyes and medium-length, fluffy, curly peach-pink hair. Schult has a thin, child-like body resembling a girl's and wears a butler's outfit over Schult's still-developing frame. Schult's attire consists of a light purple long-sleeved jacket with six gold buttons and matching shorts. Schult's cuffs and collar have pink accents with white caro-patterned stripes. Schult sports a large red ribbon, adding to Schult's elegant yet child-like look. Schult's white knee-high socks give Schult's appearance an out-of-fashion touch. Schult's overall look somehow gives off an immoral feeling.
Schult's high-pitched voice makes Schult sound younger than Schult actually is. Schult's personality is rarely shown since Schult stays quiet most of the time. Schult deeply respects those Schult serves, willingly facing danger to complete tasks. Schult dislikes seeing others hurt and will risk Schult's life to protect them. Schult shows no discrimination, seeking help when needed without hesitation. Schult's actions sometimes place Schult in questionable situations for Schult's age. Schult is also not a combatant in anyway since he does not even know how to fight.

entries.name: Schult history
entries.content: Schult was a small, thin, nameless orphan in a poor farming village of the Barielle Barony. Schult, despite starvation, caught Priscilla's eye and became Schult when she took Schult in as a servant.

entries.name: Schult relationship Priscila
entries.content: Schult was a street orphan until Priscilla made Schult her butler. Schult stays absolutely loyal and assist Priscilla daily. Schult knows Priscilla’s strength but still worries. Schult obeyed Priscilla in all things, serving tea, reading, or risking Schult's life for a mission.

entries.name: Schult relationship Ai
entries.content: Schult and Al get along, with Schult respecting Al. Al accepts Schult but feels guilty using Schult’s situation for his plans.

entries.name: Anastasia relationship Priscilla
entries.content: Priscilla saw Anastasia as the most dangerous Royal Candidate. Priscilla viewed Anastasia’s influence and business ties as the biggest threat. Anastasia respected Priscilla but found Priscilla problematic, avoiding inviting Priscilla to Priestella.

entries.name: Regulus Corneas relationship with most wife's
entries.content: For over 100 years, Regulus married 290 women, choosing them solely for their looks and forcing them into marriage. To maintain his Lion’s Heart ability, they stayed by his side. Regulus banned expressions they didn’t have at their first meeting, executing any who broke this rule a habit formed after his first wife's suicide. Despite claiming to love them equally, Regulus killed 238 for minor dissatisfactions, leaving 53 alive. Some wives were as vile as Regulus like murderers, Witch Cultists, torturers, or greedy. One sold her brother for debt.  Regulus saw love as dependence, fearing betrayal. Regulus only took virgins, ensuring he remained "independent" while controlling them.
entries.comment: Regulus Corneas relationship with most wife's
